verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

verses.original: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: || jap ||
verses.translation: Name of the Composition, "Jup". Chant And Meditate:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadh sach jugaadh sach ||
verses.translation: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach ||1||
verses.translation: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sochai soch na hoviee je sochee lakh vaar ||
verses.translation: Even if one bathes hundreds of thousands of times, the mind does not become cleansed.

verses.original: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: chupai chup na hoviee je lai rahaa liv taar ||
verses.translation: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

verses.original: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je ba(n)naa pureeaa bhaar ||
verses.translation: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahas siaanapaa lakh hoh ta ik na chalai naal ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

verses.original: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiv sachiaaraa hoieeaai kiv kooRai tuTai paal ||
verses.translation: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of falsehood be torn away?

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hukam rajaiee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kahiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee utam neech hukam likh dhukh sukh paie'eeh ||
verses.translation: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees ik hukamee sadhaa bhavaie'eeh ||
verses.translation: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko baahar hukam na koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak hukamai je bujhai ta haumai kahai na koi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan ||
verses.translation: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko dhaat jaanai neesaan ||
verses.translation: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko gun vaddiaaieeaa chaar ||
verses.translation: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko vidhiaa vikham veechaar ||
verses.translation: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh ||
verses.translation: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko jeea lai fir dheh ||
verses.translation: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko jaapai dhisai dhoor ||
verses.translation: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਾਦਰਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gaavai ko vekhai haadharaa hadhoor ||
verses.translation: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.

verses.original: ਕਥਨਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: kathanaa kathee na aavai toT ||
verses.translation: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

verses.original: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: kath kath kathee koTee koT koT ||
verses.translation: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.

verses.original: ਦੇਦਾ ਦੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhedhaa dhe laidhe thak paeh ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jugaa juga(n)tar khaahee khaeh ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee hukam chalaae raahu ||
verses.translation: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak vigasai veparavaahu ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib saach nai bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar ||
verses.translation: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh ma(n)geh dheh dheh dhaat kare dhaataar ||
verses.translation: People beg and pray, ""Give to us, give to us"", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.

verses.original: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: fer k agai rakheeaai jit dhisai dharabaar ||
verses.translation: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?

verses.original: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: muhau k bolan boleeaai jit sun dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat velaa sach naau vaddiaaiee veechaar ||
verses.translation: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karamee aavai kapaRaa nadharee mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh aape sachiaar ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||

verses.original: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: thaapiaa na jai keetaa na hoi ||
verses.translation: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap nira(n)jan soi ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa tin paiaa maan ||
verses.translation: Those who serve Him are honored.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gaaveeaai gunee nidhaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveeaai suneeaai man rakheeaai bhaau ||
verses.translation: Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh parahar sukh ghar lai jai ||
verses.translation: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naadha(n) gurmukh vedha(n) gurmukh rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur ieesar gur gorakh baramaa gur paarabatee maiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: je hau jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: guraa ik dheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||5||
verses.translation: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: teerath naavaa je tis bhaavaa vin bhaane k nai karee ||
verses.translation: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

verses.original: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: jetee siraTh upaiee vekhaa vin karamaa k milai liee ||
verses.translation: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik je ik gur kee sikh sunee ||
verses.translation: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: guraa ik dheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||6||
verses.translation: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je jug chaare aarajaa hor dhasoonee hoi ||
verses.translation: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

verses.original: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: navaa kha(n)ddaa vich jaaneeaai naal chalai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

verses.original: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)gaa naau rakhai kai jas keerat jag lei ||
verses.translation: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: je tis nadhar na aaviee ta vaat na puchhai ke ||
verses.translation: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

verses.original: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: keeTaa a(n)dhar keeT kar dhosee dhos dhare ||
verses.translation: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak niragun gun kare gunava(n)tiaa gun dhe ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

verses.original: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tehaa koi na sujhiee j tis gun koi kare ||7||
verses.translation: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai sidh peer sur naath ||
verses.translation: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਵਲ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai dharat dhaval aakaas ||
verses.translation: Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai dheep loa paataal ||
verses.translation: Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai poh na sakai kaal ||
verses.translation: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa sadhaa vigaas ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: suniaai dhookh paap kaa naas ||8||
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਇੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai ieesar baramaa i(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Listening, and connecting one's consciousness with the Name of the Eternal Being, an ordinary person can rise to the status of Shiva, Brahma, or Indra.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣ ਮੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai mukh saalaahan ma(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai jog jugat tan bhedh ||
verses.translation: Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai saasat simirat vedh ||
verses.translation: Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa sadhaa vigaas ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: suniaai dhookh paap kaa naas ||9||
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai sat sa(n)tokh giaan ||
verses.translation: Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai aThasaTh kaa isanaan ||
verses.translation: Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai paR paR paaveh maan ||
verses.translation: Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa sadhaa vigaas ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: suniaai dhookh paap kaa naas ||10||
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਰਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai saraa gunaa ke gaeh ||
verses.translation: Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai sekh peer paatisaeh ||
verses.translation: Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਅੰਧੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai a(n)dhe paaveh raahu ||
verses.translation: Listening-even the blind find the Path.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਹਾਥ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: suniaai haath hovai asagaahu ||
verses.translation: Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa sadhaa vigaas ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: suniaai dhookh paap kaa naas ||11||
verses.translation: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

verses.original: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ne kee gat kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: The state of the faithful cannot be described.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ko kahai pichhai pachhutai ||
verses.translation: One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.

verses.original: ਕਾਗਦਿ ਕਲਮ ਨ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaagadh kalam na likhanahaar ||
verses.translation: No paper, no pen, no scribe

verses.original: ਮੰਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ne kaa beh karan veechaar ||
verses.translation: can record the state of the faithful.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
verses.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||12||
verses.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai surat hovai man budh ||
verses.translation: The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai sagal bhavan kee sudh ||
verses.translation: The faithful know about all worlds and realms.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਨਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai muh choTaa naa khai ||
verses.translation: The faithful shall never be struck across the face.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai jam kai saath na jai ||
verses.translation: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
verses.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||13||
verses.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai maarag Thaak na pai ||
verses.translation: The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai pat siau paragaT jai ||
verses.translation: The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਪੰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai mag na chalai pa(n)th ||
verses.translation: The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai dharam setee sanaba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
verses.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||14||
verses.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai paaveh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: The faithful find the Door of Liberation.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai paravaarai saadhaar ||
verses.translation: The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai tarai taare gur sikh ||
verses.translation: The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਭਿਖ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)nai naanak bhaveh na bhikh ||
verses.translation: The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa naam nira(n)jan hoi ||
verses.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||15||
verses.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch paravaan pa(n)ch paradhaan ||
verses.translation: The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.

verses.original: ਪੰਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)che paaveh dharageh maan ||
verses.translation: The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਚੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਾਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)che soheh dhar raajaan ||
verses.translation: The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.

verses.original: ਪੰਚਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)chaa kaa gur ek dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: je ko kahai karai veechaar ||
verses.translation: No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਰਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karate kai karanai naahee sumaar ||
verses.translation: the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.

verses.original: ਧੌਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaual dharam dhiaa kaa poot ||
verses.translation: The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;

verses.original: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tokh thaap rakhiaa jin soot ||
verses.translation: this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: je ko bujhai hovai sachiaar ||
verses.translation: One who understands this becomes truthful.

verses.original: ਧਵਲੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhavalai upar ketaa bhaar ||
verses.translation: What a great load there is on the bull!

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਪਰੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee hor parai hor hor ||
verses.translation: So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis te bhaar talai kavan jor ||
verses.translation: What power holds them, and supports their weight?

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜਾਤਿ ਰੰਗਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਵ ॥
verses.translit: jeea jaat ra(n)gaa ke naav ||
verses.translation: The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਵੁੜੀ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa likhiaa vuRee kalaam ||
verses.translation: were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh lekhaa likh jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: Who knows how to write this account?

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕੇਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa likhiaa ketaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!

verses.original: ਕੇਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਲਿਹੁ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: ketaa taan suaalih roop ||
verses.translation: What power! What fascinating beauty!

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੌਣੁ ਕੂਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: ketee dhaat jaanai kauan koot ||
verses.translation: And what gifts! Who can know their extent?

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਸਾਉ ਏਕੋ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa pasaau eko kavaau ||
verses.translation: You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis te hoe lakh dhareeaau ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat kavan kahaa veechaar ||
verses.translation: How can Your Creative Potency be described?

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
verses.translation: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: too sadhaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||16||
verses.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਜਪ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh jap asa(n)kh bhaau ||
verses.translation: Countless meditations, countless loves.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh poojaa asa(n)kh tap taau ||
verses.translation: Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਰੰਥ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh gara(n)th mukh vedh paaTh ||
verses.translation: Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਜੋਗ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh jog man raheh udhaas ||
verses.translation: Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh bhagat gun giaan veechaar ||
verses.translation: Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਸਤੀ ਅਸੰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh satee asa(n)kh dhaataar ||
verses.translation: Countless the holy, countless the givers.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਸੂਰ ਮੁਹ ਭਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh soor muh bhakh saar ||
verses.translation: Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੋਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh mon liv lai taar ||
verses.translation: Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat kavan kahaa veechaar ||
verses.translation: How can Your Creative Potency be described?

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
verses.translation: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: too sadhaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||17||
verses.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||17||

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh moorakh a(n)dh ghor ||
verses.translation: Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਚੋਰ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh chor haraamakhor ||
verses.translation: Countless thieves and embezzlers.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਮਰ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh amar kar jaeh jor ||
verses.translation: Countless impose their will by force.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਲਵਢ ਹਤਿਆ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh galavadd hatiaa kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh paapee paap kar jaeh ||
verses.translation: Countless sinners who keep on sinning.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh kooRiaar kooRe firaeh ||
verses.translation: Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਮਲੇਛ ਮਲੁ ਭਖਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh malechh mal bhakh khaeh ||
verses.translation: Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh ni(n)dhak sir kareh bhaar ||
verses.translation: Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak neech kahai veechaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
verses.translation: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: too sadhaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||18||
verses.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵ ਅਸੰਖ ਥਾਵ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh naav asa(n)kh thaav ||
verses.translation: Countless names, countless places.

verses.original: ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਲੋਅ ॥
verses.translit: aga(n)m aga(n)m asa(n)kh loa ||
verses.translation: Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh kaheh sir bhaar hoi ||
verses.translation: Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.

verses.original: ਅਖਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: akharee naam akharee saalaeh ||
verses.translation: From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.

verses.original: ਅਖਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: akharee giaan geet gun gaeh ||
verses.translation: From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.

verses.original: ਅਖਰੀ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: akharee likhan bolan baan ||
verses.translation: From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.

verses.original: ਅਖਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: akharaa sir sa(n)jog vakhaan ||
verses.translation: From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh likhe tis sir naeh ||
verses.translation: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.

verses.original: ਜਿਵ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ਤਿਵ ਤਿਵ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiv furamaae tiv tiv paeh ||
verses.translation: As He ordains, so do we receive.

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਤਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa keetaa tetaa naau ||
verses.translation: The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai naahee ko thaau ||
verses.translation: Without Your Name, there is no place at all.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat kavan kahaa veechaar ||
verses.translation: How can I describe Your Creative Power?

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar ||
verses.translation: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: too sadhaa salaamat nira(n)kaar ||19||
verses.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||

verses.original: ਭਰੀਐ ਹਥੁ ਪੈਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhareeaai hath pair tan dheh ||
verses.translation: When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਧੋਤੈ ਉਤਰਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: paanee dhotai utaras kheh ||
verses.translation: water can wash away the dirt.

verses.original: ਮੂਤ ਪਲੀਤੀ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: moot paleetee kapaR hoi ||
verses.translation: When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,

verses.original: ਦੇ ਸਾਬੂਣੁ ਲਈਐ ਓਹੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhe saaboon lieeaai oh dhoi ||
verses.translation: soap can wash them clean.

verses.original: ਭਰੀਐ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhareeaai mat paapaa kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: oh dhopai naavai kai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਆਖਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)nee paapee aakhan naeh ||
verses.translation: Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar karanaa likh lai jaahu ||
verses.translation: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape beej aape hee khaahu ||
verses.translation: You shall harvest what you plant.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak hukamee aavahu jaahu ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤਪੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: teerath tap dhiaa dhat dhaan ||
verses.translation: Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: je ko paavai til kaa maan ||
verses.translation: these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: suniaa ma(n)niaa man keetaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)taragat teerath mal naau ||
verses.translation: cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh gun tere mai naahee koi ||
verses.translation: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin gun keete bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਆਥਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਰਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: suasat aath baanee baramaau ||
verses.translation: I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sat suhaan sadhaa man chaau ||
verses.translation: He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.

verses.original: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su velaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar ||
verses.translation: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?

verses.original: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kavan s rutee maahu kavan jit hoaa aakaar ||
verses.translation: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?

verses.original: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: vel na paieeaa pa(n)ddatee j hovai lekh puraan ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: vakhat na paio kaadheeaa j likhan lekh kuraan ||
verses.translation: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.

verses.original: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa koiee ||
verses.translation: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa karataa siraThee kau saaje aape jaanai soiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.

verses.original: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee kiau varanee kiv jaanaa ||
verses.translation: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik dhoo ik siaanaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa saahib vaddee naiee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||
verses.translation: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak je ko aapau jaanai agai giaa na sohai ||21||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਲਖ ਆਗਾਸਾ ਆਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: paataalaa paataal lakh aagaasaa aagaas ||
verses.translation: There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

verses.original: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: oRak oRak bhaal thake vedh kahan ik vaat ||
verses.translation: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: sahas aThaareh kahan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat ||
verses.translation: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa hoi ta likheeaai lekhai hoi vinaas ||
verses.translation: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vaddaa aakheeaai aape jaanai aap ||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahee saalaeh etee surat na paieeaa ||
verses.translation: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

verses.original: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: nadheeaa atai vaeh paveh samu(n)dh na jaane'eeh ||
verses.translation: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

verses.original: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: samu(n)dh saeh sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan ||
verses.translation: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth

verses.original: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: keeRee tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesareh ||23||
verses.translation: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na sifatee kahan na a(n)t ||
verses.translation: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na karanai dhen na a(n)t ||
verses.translation: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na vekhan sunan na a(n)t ||
verses.translation: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na jaapai kiaa man ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na jaapai keetaa aakaar ||
verses.translation: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na jaapai paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaaran kete bilalaeh ||
verses.translation: Many struggle to know His limits,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: taa ke a(n)t na paae jaeh ||
verses.translation: but His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: No one can know these limits.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahutaa kaheeaai bahutaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa saahib uoochaa thaau ||
verses.translation: Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.

verses.original: ਊਚੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਊਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooche upar uoochaa naau ||
verses.translation: Highest of the High, above all is His Name.

verses.original: ਏਵਡੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: evadd uoochaa hovai koi ||
verses.translation: Only one as Great and as High as God

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਚੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis uooche kau jaanai soi ||
verses.translation: can know His Lofty and Exalted State.

verses.original: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jevadd aap jaanai aap aap ||
verses.translation: Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee karamee dhaat ||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahutaa karam likhiaa naa jai ||
verses.translation: His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa dhaataa til na tamai ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver does not hold back anything.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kete ma(n)geh jodh apaar ||
verses.translation: There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ketiaa ganat nahee veechaar ||
verses.translation: So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਖਪਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kete khap tuTeh vekaar ||
verses.translation: So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kete lai lai mukar paeh ||
verses.translation: So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kete moorakh khaahee khaeh ||
verses.translation: So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.

verses.original: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਦ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ketiaa dhookh bhookh sadh maar ||
verses.translation: So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਭਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eh bh dhaat teree dhaataar ||
verses.translation: Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!

verses.original: ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dh khalaasee bhaanai hoi ||
verses.translation: Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hor aakh na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: No one else has any say in this.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਇਕੁ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ko khaik aakhan pai ||
verses.translation: If some fool should presume to say that he does,

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇਤੀਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh jaanai jeteeaa muh khai ||
verses.translation: he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai aape dhei ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows, He Himself gives.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿ ਭਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh s bh keiee kei ||
verses.translation: Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhase sifat saalaeh ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak paatisaahee paatisaahu ||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: amul gun amul vaapaar ||
verses.translation: Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਮੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: amul vaapaare'e amul bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਮੁਲ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: amul aaveh amul lai jaeh ||
verses.translation: Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲ ਭਾਇ ਅਮੁਲਾ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: amul bhai amulaa samaeh ||
verses.translation: Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: amul dharam amul dheebaan ||
verses.translation: Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਤੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: amul tul amul paravaan ||
verses.translation: Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: amul bakhasees amul neesaan ||
verses.translation: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: amul karam amul furamaan ||
verses.translation: Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.

verses.original: ਅਮੁਲੋ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਆਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: amulo amul aakhiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!

verses.original: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakh aakh rahe liv lai ||
verses.translation: Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh vedh paaTh puraan ||
verses.translation: The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh paRe kareh vakhiaan ||
verses.translation: The scholars speak and lecture.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਬਰਮੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਇੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh barame aakheh i(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਤੈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh gopee tai govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Gopis and Krishna speak.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਈਸਰ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿਧ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh ieesar aakheh sidh ||
verses.translation: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਬੁਧ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh kete keete budh ||
verses.translation: The many created Buddhas speak.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਆਖਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh dhaanav aakheh dhev ||
verses.translation: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh sur nar mun jan sev ||
verses.translation: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kete aakheh aakhan paeh ||
verses.translation: Many speak and try to describe Him.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kete keh keh uTh uTh jaeh ||
verses.translation: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ete keete hor kareh ||
verses.translation: If He were to create as many again as there already are,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa aakh na sakeh keiee kei ||
verses.translation: even then, they could not describe Him.

verses.original: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jevadd bhaavai tevadd hoi ||
verses.translation: He is as Great as He wishes to be.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jaanai saachaa soi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬੋਲੁਵਿਗਾੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: je ko aakhai boluvigaaR ||
verses.translation: If anyone presumes to describe God,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: taa likheeaai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar ||26||
verses.translation: he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so dhar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||
verses.translation: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete vaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kete raag paree siau kaheean kete gaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh tuhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
verses.translation: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh dharam veechaare ||
verses.translation: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh ieesar baramaa dhevee sohan sadhaa savaare ||
verses.translation: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh i(n)dh idhaasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
verses.translation: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan saadh vichaare ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaaveh veer karaare ||
verses.translation: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesar jug jug vedhaa naale ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh mohaneeaa man mohan suragaa machh piaale ||
verses.translation: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
verses.translation: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh jodh mahaabal sooraa gaaveh khaanee chaare ||
verses.translation: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe dhaare ||
verses.translation: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee tudhuno gaaveh jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
verses.translation: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare ||
verses.translation: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
verses.translation: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
verses.translation: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

verses.original: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
verses.translation: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||27||
verses.translation: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhaa sa(n)tokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee kareh bibhoot ||
verses.translation: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

verses.original: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: khi(n)thaa kaal kuaaree kaiaa jugat dda(n)ddaa parateet ||
verses.translation: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.

verses.original: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaiee pa(n)thee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet ||
verses.translation: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.

verses.original: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
verses.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||28||
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||

verses.original: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: bhugat giaan dhiaa bha(n)ddaaran ghaT ghaT vaajeh naadh ||
verses.translation: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saadh ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jog vijog dhui kaar chalaaveh lekhe aaveh bhaag ||
verses.translation: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.

verses.original: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
verses.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||29||
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa maiee jugat viaaiee tin chele paravaan ||
verses.translation: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik sa(n)saaree ik bha(n)ddaaree ik laae dheebaan ||
verses.translation: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.

verses.original: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furamaan ||
verses.translation: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: oh vekhai onaa nadhar na aavai bahutaa eh viddaan ||
verses.translation: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!

verses.original: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
verses.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||30||
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||

verses.original: ਆਸਣੁ ਲੋਇ ਲੋਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aasan loi loi bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh paiaa su ekaa vaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sache kee saachee kaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
verses.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||31||
verses.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhoo jeebhau lakh hoh lakh hoveh lakh vees ||
verses.translation: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,

verses.original: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: lakh lakh geRaa aakhe'eeh ek naam jagadhees ||
verses.translation: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: et raeh pat pavaReeaa chaReeaai hoi ikees ||
verses.translation: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: sun galaa aakaas kee keeTaa aaiee rees ||
verses.translation: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai kooRee kooRai Thees ||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਚੁਪੈ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan jor chupai neh jor ||
verses.translation: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

verses.original: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jor na ma(n)gan dhen na jor ||
verses.translation: No power to beg, no power to give.

verses.original: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jor na jeevan maran neh jor ||
verses.translation: No power to live, no power to die.

verses.original: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jor na raaj maal man sor ||
verses.translation: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.

verses.original: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jor na suratee giaan veechaar ||
verses.translation: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.

verses.original: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jor na jugatee chhuTai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: No power to find the way to escape from the world.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis hath jor kar vekhai soi ||
verses.translation: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak utam neech na koi ||33||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||

verses.original: ਰਾਤੀ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: raatee rutee thitee vaar ||
verses.translation: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;

verses.original: ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: pavan paanee aganee paataal ||
verses.translation: wind, water, fire and the nether regions

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal ||
verses.translation: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich jeea jugat ke ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke naam anek ana(n)t ||
verses.translation: Their names are uncounted and endless.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karamee karamee hoi veechaar ||
verses.translation: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa aap sachaa dharabaar ||
verses.translation: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tithai sohan pa(n)ch paravaan ||
verses.translation: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee karam pavai neesaan ||
verses.translation: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਓਥੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kach pakaiee othai pai ||
verses.translation: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak giaa jaapai jai ||34||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਹੋ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharam kha(n)dd kaa eho dharam ||
verses.translation: This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਆਖਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan kha(n)dd kaa aakhahu karam ||
verses.translation: And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: kete pavan paanee vaisa(n)tar kete kaan mahes ||
verses.translation: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: kete barame ghaaRat ghaRe'eh roop ra(n)g ke ves ||
verses.translation: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: keteeaa karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upadhes ||
verses.translation: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: kete i(n)dh cha(n)dh soor kete kete ma(n)ddal dhes ||
verses.translation: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: kete sidh budh naath kete kete dhevee ves ||
verses.translation: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: kete dhev dhaanav mun kete kete ratan samu(n)dh ||
verses.translation: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: keteeaa khaanee keteeaa baanee kete paat nari(n)dh ||
verses.translation: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: keteeaa suratee sevak kete naanak a(n)t na a(n)t ||35||
verses.translation: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਚੰਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan kha(n)dd meh giaan paracha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: tithai naadh binodh kodd ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.

verses.original: ਸਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: saram kha(n)dd kee baanee roop ||
verses.translation: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: tithai ghaaRat ghaReeaai bahut anoop ||
verses.translation: Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaeh ||
verses.translation: These things cannot be described.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je ko kahai pichhai pachhutai ||
verses.translation: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: tithai ghaReeaai surat mat man budh ||
verses.translation: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: tithai ghaReeaai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||
verses.translation: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karam kha(n)dd kee baanee jor ||
verses.translation: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tithai hor na koiee hor ||
verses.translation: No one else dwells there,

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: tithai jodh mahaabal soor ||
verses.translation: except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: tin meh raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੀਤੋ ਸੀਤਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tithai seeto seetaa mahimaa maeh ||
verses.translation: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: taa ke roop na kathane jaeh ||
verses.translation: Their beauty cannot be described.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh mareh na Thaage jaeh ||
verses.translation: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai raam vasai man maeh ||
verses.translation: within whose minds the Lord abides.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
verses.translit: tithai bhagat vaseh ke loa ||
verses.translation: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kareh ana(n)dh sachaa man soi ||
verses.translation: They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach kha(n)dd vasai nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai nadhar nihaal ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡ ॥
verses.translit: tithai kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||
verses.translation: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tithai loa loa aakaar ||
verses.translation: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

verses.original: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||
verses.translation: As He commands, so they exist.

verses.original: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vekhai vigasai kar veechaar ||
verses.translation: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: naanak kathanaa karaRaa saar ||37||
verses.translation: O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jat paahaaraa dheeraj suniaar ||
verses.translation: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.

verses.original: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਦੁ ਹਥੀਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aharan mat vedh hatheeaar ||
verses.translation: Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਖਲਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhau khalaa agan tap taau ||
verses.translation: With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.

verses.original: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਭਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਢਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaa(n)ddaa bhaau a(n)mrit tit ddaal ||
verses.translation: In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,

verses.original: ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਟਕਸਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ghaReeaai sabadh sachee Takasaal ||
verses.translation: and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau nadhar karam tin kaar ||
verses.translation: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee nadhar nihaal ||38||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
verses.translation: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

verses.original: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhivas raat dhui dhaiee dhaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
verses.translation: Day and night are each like the nanny and her caregiving husband, in whose lap the whole world is at play.

verses.original: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)giaaieeaa buriaaieeaa vaachai dharam hadhoor ||
verses.translation: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke dhoor ||
verses.translation: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ge masakat ghaal ||
verses.translation: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhuTee naal ||1||
verses.translation: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
verses.translit: so dhar raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa
verses.translation: So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so dhar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||
verses.translation: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje tere naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kete tere raag paree siau kahe'eeh kete tere gaavanahaare ||
verses.translation: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano pavan paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
verses.translation: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam beechaare ||
verses.translation: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano ieesar brahamaa dhevee sohan tere sadhaa savaare ||
verses.translation: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
verses.translation: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan tudhano saadh beechaare ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
verses.translation: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesur jug jug vedhaa naale ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh piaale ||
verses.translation: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
verses.translation: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavan tudhano khaanee chaare ||
verses.translation: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan tudhano kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
verses.translation: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee tudhano gaavan jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
verses.translation: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
verses.translation: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
verses.translation: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
verses.translation: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

verses.original: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
verses.translation: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar dhekhai keetaa aapanaa jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so paatisaahu saahaa patisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sun vaddaa aakhai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kevadd vaddaa ddeeThaa hoi ||
verses.translation: But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: keemat pai na kahiaa jai ||
verses.translation: His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.

verses.original: ਕਹਣੈ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahanai vaale tere rahe samai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
verses.translation: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koi na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh suratee mil surat kamaiee ||
verses.translation: All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh keemat mil keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee dhiaanee gur gurahaiee ||
verses.translation: The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers

verses.original: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahan na jaiee teree til vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,

verses.original: ਸਿਧਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sidhaa purakhaa keeaa vaddiaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paieeaa ||
verses.translation: without You, no one has attained such powers.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam milai naahee Thaak rahaieeaa ||3||
verses.translation: They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan vaalaa kiaa vechaaraa ||
