verses.translation: What can the poor helpless creatures do?

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sifatee bhare tere bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis too dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਖਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan aaukhaa saachaa naau ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: saache naam kee laagai bhookh ||
verses.translation: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,

verses.original: ਉਤੁ ਭੂਖੈ ਖਾਇ ਚਲੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aut bhookhai khai chale'eeh dhookh ||1||
verses.translation: that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau visarai meree mai ||
verses.translation: How can I forget Him, O my mother?

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib saachai nai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saache naam kee til vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,

verses.original: ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aakh thake keemat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh ||
verses.translation: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaddaa na hovai ghaaT na jai ||2||
verses.translation: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh marai na hovai sog ||
verses.translation: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.

verses.original: ਦੇਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhedhaa rahai na chookai bhog ||
verses.translation: He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.

verses.original: ਗੁਣੁ ਏਹੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun eho hor naahee koi ||
verses.translation: This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
verses.translation: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jevadd aap tevadd teree dhaat ||
verses.translation: As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhin kar kai keetee raat ||
verses.translation: The One who created the day also created the night.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: khasam visaareh te kamajaat ||
verses.translation: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naavai baajh sanaat ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: raag goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke jan satigur satapurakhaa binau karau gur paas ||
verses.translation: O humble servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being: I offer my humble prayer to You, O Guru.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham keere kiram satigur saranaiee kar dhiaa naam paragaas ||1||
verses.translation: I am a mere insect, a worm. O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be merciful, and bless me with the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere meet gurdhev mo kau raam naam paragaas ||
verses.translation: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat naam meraa praan sakhaiee har keerat hamaree raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: har jan ke vadd bhaag vaddere jin har har saradhaa har piaas ||
verses.translation: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har naam milai tirapataaseh mil sa(n)gat gun paragaas ||2||
verses.translation: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin har har har ras naam na paiaa te bhaagaheen jam paas ||
verses.translation: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo satigur saran sa(n)gat nahee aae dhirag jeeve dhirag jeevaas ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the Holy Congregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin har jan satigur sa(n)gat paiee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas ||
verses.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n satasa(n)gat jit har ras paiaa mil jan naanak naam paragaas ||4||4||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essence is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shines forth. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raag goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe re man chitaveh udham jaa aahar har jeeau pariaa ||
verses.translation: Why, O mind, do you plot and plan, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

verses.original: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sail pathar meh ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||
verses.translation: From rocks and stones He created living beings; He places their nourishment before them. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile su tariaa ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Lord of souls, one who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa sooke kaasaT hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained, and the dry wood blossoms forth again in lush greenery. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koi na kis kee dhariaa ||
verses.translation: Mothers, fathers, friends, children and spouses-no one is the support of anyone else.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe Thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||
verses.translation: For each and every person, our Lord and Master provides sustenance. Why are you so afraid, O mind? ||2||

verses.original: ਊਡੇ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: uoodde uoodd aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa ||
verses.translation: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਵਣੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simaran kariaa ||3||
verses.translation: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nidhaan dhas asaT sidhaan Thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||
verses.translation: All the nine treasures, and the eighteen supernatural powers are held by our Lord and Master in the Palm of His Hand.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bal bal sadh bal jaieeaai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa so purakhu
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, So Purakh ~ That Primal Being:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dhookh visaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har aape Thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa ||
verses.translation: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape dhaataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin kurabaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukhavaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: se mukat se mukat bhe jin har dhiaaiaa jee tin tooTee jam kee faasee ||
verses.translation: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin nirabhau jin har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jee tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa jin seviaa meraa har jee te har har roop samaasee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jee jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar jee bhare bia(n)t bea(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
verses.translation: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh bea(n)taa ||
verses.translation: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere anek tere anek paReh bahu simirat saasat jee kar kiriaa khaT karam kara(n)taa ||
verses.translation: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
verses.translation: Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jug jug eko sadhaa sadhaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soiee ||
verses.translation: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape bhaavai soiee varatai jee too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
verses.translation: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape sirasaT sabh upaiee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoiee ||5||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa sachiaar maiddaa saa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tau bhaavai soiee theesee jo too(n) dheh soiee hau paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teree too(n) sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: All belong to You, all meditate on you.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kareh tin naam ratan paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh laadhaa manmukh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudh aap vichhoRiaa aap milaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh ||
verses.translation: You are the River of Life; all are within You.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin dhoojaa koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: There is no one except You.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh teraa khel ||
verses.translation: All living beings are Your playthings.

verses.original: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vijog mil vichhuRiaa sa(n)jogee mel ||2||
verses.translation: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too jaanaieh soiee jan jaanai ||
verses.translation: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun sadh hee aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve You find peace.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahaje hee har naam samaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: There is no one except You.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
verses.translation: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gurmukh paragaT hoi ||4||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tit saravaraRai bhieele nivaasaa paanee paavak tineh keeaa ||
verses.translation: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!

verses.original: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dhekhaa teh ddoobeeale ||1||
verses.translation: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
verses.translation: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhiaa ||
verses.translation: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak tin kee saranaa jin too naahee veesariaa ||2||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhiee paraapat maanukh dhehureeaa ||
verses.translation: This human body has been given to you.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh milan kee ieh teree bareeaa ||
verses.translation: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
verses.translation: Nothing else will work.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)gat bhaj keval naam ||1||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: sara(n)jaam laag bhavajal taran kai ||
verses.translation: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam birathaa jaat ra(n)g maiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ham neech kara(n)maa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa ||2||4||
verses.translation: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
verses.translit: sohilaa raag gauRee dheepakee mahalaa pehilaa
verses.translation: Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jai ghar keerat aakheeaai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
verses.translation: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarih sirajanahaaro ||1||
verses.translation: -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
verses.translation: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree jit sohilai sadhaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dhekhaigaa dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tere dhaanai keemat naa pavai tis dhaate kavan sumaar ||2||
verses.translation: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
verses.translation: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dheh sajan aseesaReeaa jiau hovai saahib siau mel ||3||
verses.translation: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadhaRe nit pava(n)n ||
verses.translation: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

verses.original: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhanahaaraa simareeaai naanak se dheh aava(n)n ||4||1||
verses.translation: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: chhia ghar chhia gur chhia upadhes ||
verses.translation: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur gur eko ves anek ||1||
verses.translation: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa jai ghar karate keerat hoi ||
verses.translation: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung

verses.original: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so ghar raakh vaddaiee toi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu hoaa ||
verses.translation: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: sooraj eko rut anek ||
verses.translation: and the various seasons originate from the one sun;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak karate ke kete ves ||2||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gagan mai thaal rav cha(n)dh dheepak bane taarikaa ma(n)ddal janak motee ||
verses.translation: Upon that cosmic plate of the sky, the sun and the moon are the lamps. The stars and their orbs are the studded pearls.

verses.original: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoop malaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banarai foola(n)t jotee ||1||
verses.translation: The fragrance of sandalwood in the air is the temple incense, and the wind is the fan. All the plants of the world are the altar flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaisee aaratee hoi || bhav kha(n)ddanaa teree aaratee ||
verses.translation: What a beautiful Aartee, lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of Fear, this is Your Ceremony of Light.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anahataa sabadh vaaja(n)t bheree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad is the vibration of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋੁਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahas tav nain nan nain heh toh kau sahas moorat nanaa ek tuohee ||
verses.translation: You have thousands of eyes, and yet You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms, and yet You do not have even one.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahas padh bimal nan ek padh ga(n)dh bin sahas tav ga(n)dh iv chalat mohee ||2||
verses.translation: You have thousands of Lotus Feet, and yet You do not have even one foot. You have no nose, but you have thousands of noses. This Play of Yours entrances me. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh jot jot hai soi ||
verses.translation: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhai chaanan sabh meh chaanan hoi ||
verses.translation: By this Illumination, that Light is radiant within all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur saakhee jot paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Light shines forth.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai su aaratee hoi ||3||
verses.translation: That which is pleasing to Him is the lamp-lit worship service. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har charan kaval makara(n)dh lobhit mano anadhinuo moh aahee piaasaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is enticed by the honey-sweet Lotus Feet of the Lord. Day and night, I thirst for them.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kirapaa jal dheh naanak saari(n)g kau hoi jaa te terai nai vaasaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Bestow the Water of Your Mercy upon Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, so that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)ddal kha(n)ddaa he ||
verses.translation: The body-village is filled to overflowing with anger and sexual desire; these were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poorab likhat likhe gur paiaa man har liv ma(n)ddal ma(n)ddaa he ||1||
verses.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pun vaddaa he ||
verses.translation: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar dda(n)ddaut pun vaddaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat har ras saadh na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)ddaa he ||
verses.translation: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the Taste of the Lord's Sublime Essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dhukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir dda(n)ddaa he ||2||
verses.translation: The more they walk away, the deeper it pierces them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan har har naam samaane dhukh janam maran bhav kha(n)ddaa he ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: abinaasee purakh paiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)dd brahama(n)ddaa he ||3||
verses.translation: They have found the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they receive great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he ||
verses.translation: I am poor and meek, God, but I belong to You! Save me-please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam adhaar Tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)ddaa he ||4||4||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: karau bena(n)tee sunahu mere meetaa sa(n)t Tahal kee belaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa khaaT chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa ||1||
verses.translation: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਾਰੇ ॥ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaudh ghaTai dhinas rainaare || man gur mil kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This life is diminishing, day and night. Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih sa(n)saar bikaar sa(n)se meh tario braham giaanee ||
verses.translation: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiseh jagai peeaavai ih ras akath kathaa tin jaanee ||2||
verses.translation: Only those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this Sublime Essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau aae soiee bihaajhahu har gur te maneh baseraa ||
verses.translation: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nij ghar mahal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoigo feraa ||3||
verses.translation: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore ||
verses.translation: O Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts, O Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas ihai sukh maagai mo kau kar sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||4||5||
verses.translation: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag sireeraag mahalaa pahilaa 1 ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Siree Raag, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਊਸਰਹਿ ਰਤਨੀ ਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: motee ta ma(n)dhar uoosareh ratanee ta hoh jaRaau ||
verses.translation: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,

verses.original: ਕਸਤੂਰਿ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਰਿ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਲੀਪਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kasatoor ku(n)goo agar cha(n)dhan leep aavai chaau ||
verses.translation: scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||1||
verses.translation: -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bin jeeau jal bal jaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai aapanaa gur poochh dhekhiaa avar naahee thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਤੀ ਪਲਘਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee ta heere laal jaRatee palagh laal jaRaau ||
verses.translation: If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed was encased with rubies,

verses.original: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mohanee mukh manee sohai kare ra(n)g pasaau ||
verses.translation: and if heavenly beauties, their faces adorned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||2||
verses.translation: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਧੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਈ ਰਿਧਿ ਆਖਾ ਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: sidh hovaa sidh laiee ridh aakhaa aau ||
verses.translation: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gupat paragaT hoi baisaa lok raakhai bhaau ||
verses.translation: and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||3||
verses.translation: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sulataan hovaa mel lasakar takhat raakhaa paau ||
verses.translation: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukam haasal karee baiThaa naanakaa sabh vaau ||
verses.translation: issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puff of wind.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||4||1||
verses.translation: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT koTee meree aarajaa pavan peean apiaau ||
verses.translation: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸਉਣ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui gufai na dhekhaa supanai saun na thaau ||
verses.translation: and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||1||
verses.translation: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa nira(n)kaar nij thai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun aakhan aakhanaa je bhaavai kare tamai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord, please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਣਿ ਪੀਸਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kusaa kaTeeaa vaar vaar peesan peesaa pai ||
verses.translation: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill and ground into flour,

verses.original: ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੀਆ ਭਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: agee setee jaaleeaa bhasam setee ral jaau ||
verses.translation: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||2||
verses.translation: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇ ਭਵਾ ਸੈ ਅਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)khee hoi kai je bhavaa sai asamaanee jaau ||
verses.translation: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਵਊ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੀਆ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee kisai na aavuoo naa kichh peeaa na khaau ||
verses.translation: and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||3||
verses.translation: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਗਦ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kaagadh lakh manaa paR paR keechai bhaau ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,

verses.original: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਚਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: masoo toT na aaviee lekhan paun chalaau ||
verses.translation: and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||4||2||
verses.translation: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lekhai bolan bolanaa lekhai khaanaa khaau ||
verses.translation: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consume their food.

verses.original: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lekhai vaaT chalaieeaa lekhai sun vekhaau ||
verses.translation: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.

verses.original: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lekhai saeh lavaie'eeh paRe k puchhan jaau ||1||
verses.translation: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholars about this? ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਨਾ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa maiaa rachanaa dhoh ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhai naam visaariaa naa tis eh na oh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan maranaa jai kai ethai khaajai kaal ||
verses.translation: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jithai beh samajhaieeaai tithai koi na chalio naal ||
verses.translation: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rovan vaale jetaRe sabh ba(n)neh pa(n)dd paraal ||2||
verses.translation: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut ghaT na aakhai koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kinai na paieeaa kahan na vaddaa hoi ||
verses.translation: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahab ek too hor jeeaa kete loa ||3||
verses.translation: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds. ||3||

verses.original: ਨੀਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਨੀਚੀ ਹੂ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: neechaa a(n)dhar neech jaat neechee hoo at neech || naanak tin kai sa(n)g saath vaddiaa siau kiaa rees ||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low. Why should he try to compete with the great?

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jithai neech samaaleean tithai nadhar teree bakhasees ||4||3||
verses.translation: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਠਗਿ ਖਾਧਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab kutaa kooR choohaRaa Thag khaadhaa muradhaar ||
verses.translation: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa par mal mukh sudhee agan karodh cha(n)ddaal ||
verses.translation: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.

verses.original: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ras kas aap salaahanaa e karam mere karataar ||1||
verses.translation: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa boleeaai pat hoi ||
verses.translation: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uootam se dhar uootam kahe'eeh neech karam beh roi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ras suinaa ras rupaa kaaman ras paramal kee vaas ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of the fragrance of sandalwood,

verses.original: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ras ghoRe ras sejaa ma(n)dhar ras meeThaa ras maas ||
verses.translation: the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ete ras sareer ke kai ghaT naam nivaas ||2||
verses.translation: -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jit boliaai pat paieeaai so boliaa paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.

verses.original: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: fikaa bol viguchanaa sun moorakh man ajaan ||
verses.translation: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿ ਕਹਣ ਵਖਾਣ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaaveh se bhale hor k kahan vakhaan ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin mat tin pat tin dhan palai jin hiradhai rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਅਵਰ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa kiaa saalaahanaa avar suaaliau kai ||
verses.translation: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਦਾਨਿ ਨ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee baahare raacheh dhaan na nai ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਮਲੁ ਗਲੋਲਾ ਕੂੜ ਕਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: amal galolaa kooR kaa dhitaa dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.

verses.original: ਮਤੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: matee maran visaariaa khusee keetee dhin chaar ||
verses.translation: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਫੀਆ ਰਾਖਣ ਕਉ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach miliaa tin sofeeaa raakhan kau dharavaar ||1||
verses.translation: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saache kau sach jaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit seviaai sukh paieeaai teree dharageh chalai maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਗੁੜ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach saraa guR baaharaa jis vich sachaa naau ||
verses.translation: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: suneh vakhaaneh jetaRe hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa man kheevaa jaaneeaai jaa mahalee paae thaau ||2||
verses.translation: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naau neer cha(n)giaaieeaa sat paramal tan vaas ||
verses.translation: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: taa mukh hovai ujalaa lakh dhaatee ik dhaat ||
verses.translation: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhookh tisai peh aakhe'eeh sookh jisai hee paas ||3||
verses.translation: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau manahu visaareeaai jaa ke jeea paraan ||
verses.translation: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis vin sabh apavitr hai jetaa painan khaan ||
verses.translation: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: hor galaa(n) sabh kooReeaa tudh bhaavai paravaan ||4||5||
verses.translation: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahal pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaal moh ghas mas kar mat kaagadh kar saar ||
verses.translation: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau kalam kar chit lekhaaree gur puchh likh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.

verses.original: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: likh naam saalaeh likh likh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
verses.translation: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa eh lekhaa likh jaan ||
verses.translation: O Baba, write such an account,

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai tithai hoi sachaa neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jithai mileh vaddiaaieeaa sadh khuseeaa sadh chaau ||
verses.translation: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin mukh Tike nikaleh jin man sachaa naau ||
verses.translation: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam milai taa paieeaai naahee galee vaau dhuaau ||2||
verses.translation: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik aaveh ik jaeh uTh rakhe'eeh naav salaar ||
verses.translation: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik upaae ma(n)gate ikanaa vadde dharavaar ||
verses.translation: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: agai giaa jaaneeaai vin naavai vekaar ||3||
verses.translation: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhai terai ddar agalaa khap khap chhijai dheh ||
verses.translation: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.

verses.original: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: naav jinaa sulataan khaan hodhe ddiThe kheh ||
verses.translation: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak uThee chaliaa sabh kooRe tuTe neh ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ras miThe ma(n)niaai suniaai saalone ||
verses.translation: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;

verses.original: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: khaT turasee mukh bolanaa maaran naadh ke'ee ||
verses.translation: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.

verses.original: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhateeh a(n)mirat bhaau ek jaa kau nadhar karei ||1||
verses.translation: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa hor khaanaa khusee khuaar ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit khaadhai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: rataa painan man rataa supedhee sat dhaan ||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.

verses.original: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: neelee siaahee kadhaa karanee pahiran pair dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Erasing the blackness of sin is my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.

verses.original: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kamaraba(n)dh sa(n)tokh kaa dhan joban teraa naam ||2||
verses.translation: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa hor painan khusee khuaar ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit paidhai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: ghoRe paakhar suine saakhat boojhan teree vaaT ||
verses.translation: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.

verses.original: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: tarakas teer kamaan saa(n)g tegaba(n)dh gun dhaat ||
verses.translation: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.

verses.original: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaajaa nejaa pat siau paragaT karam teraa meree jaat ||3||
verses.translation: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa hor chaRanaa khusee khuaar ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit chaRiaai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ma(n)dhar khusee naam kee nadhar teree paravaar ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hukam soiee tudh bhaavasee hor aakhan bahut apaar ||
verses.translation: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa paatisaahu poochh na kare beechaar ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa hor saunaa khusee khuaar ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: jit sutai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||4||7||
verses.translation: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)goo kee kaa(n)iaa ratanaa kee lalitaa agar vaas tan saas ||
verses.translation: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath kaa mukh Tikaa tit ghaT mat vigaas ||
verses.translation: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

verses.original: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ot matee saalaahanaa sach naam gunataas ||1||
verses.translation: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa hor mat hor hor ||
verses.translation: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je sau ver kamaieeaai kooRai kooRaa jor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pooj lagai peer aakheeaai sabh milai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naau sadhaae aapanaa hovai sidh sumaar ||
verses.translation: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa pat lekhai naa pavai sabhaa pooj khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau satigur thaapiaa tin meT na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: onaa a(n)dhar naam nidhaan hai naamo paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naau poojeeaai naau ma(n)neeaai akha(n)dd sadhaa sach soi ||3||
verses.translation: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

verses.original: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: khehoo kheh ralaieeaai taa jeeau kehaa hoi ||
verses.translation: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

verses.original: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaleeaa sabh siaanapaa uThee chaliaa roi ||
verses.translation: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam visaariaai dhar giaa kiaa hoi ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee gun veetharai aaugunava(n)tee jhoor ||
verses.translation: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: je loReh var kaamanee neh mileeaai pir koor ||
verses.translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa paieeaai pir dhoor ||1||
verses.translation: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur poorai takhat addol ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pooraa je kare paieeaai saach atol ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: prabh harima(n)dhar sohanaa tis meh maanak laal || motee heeraa niramalaa ka(n)chan koT reesaal ||
verses.translation: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful. Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin pauRee gaR kiau chaRau gur har dhiaan nihaal ||2||
verses.translation: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pauRee beRee guroo gur tulahaa har naau ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sar saagar bohitho gur teerath dhareeaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je tis bhaavai uoojalee sat sar naavan jaau ||3||
verses.translation: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: pooro pooro aakheeaai poorai takhat nivaas ||
verses.translation: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: poorai thaan suhaavanai poorai aas niraas ||
verses.translation: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak pooraa je milai kiau ghaaTai gun taas ||4||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu bhaine gal mileh a(n)k sahelaReeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
verses.translit: mil kai kareh kahaaneeaa sa(n)mrath ka(n)t keeaaeh ||
verses.translation: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saache saahib sabh gun aaugan sabh asaeh ||1||
verses.translation: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: karataa sabh ko terai jor ||
verses.translation: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh beechaareeaai jaa too taa kiaa hor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: jai puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee guna(n)ee ||
verses.translation: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, ""By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?""

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sa(n)tokh seegaareeaa miThaa bolanee ||
verses.translation: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabadh sunee ||2||
verses.translation: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.""||2||

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: keteeaa tereeaa kudharatee kevadd teree dhaat ||
verses.translation: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kete tere jeea ja(n)t sifat kareh dhin raat ||
verses.translation: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kete tere roop ra(n)g kete jaat ajaat ||3||
verses.translation: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach milai sach uoopajai sach meh saach samai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: surat hovai pat uoogavai gurbachanee bhau khai ||
verses.translation: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape le milai ||4||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhalee saree j ubaree haumai muiee gharaahu ||
verses.translation: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

verses.original: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhoot lage fir chaakaree satigur kaa vesaahu ||
verses.translation: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kalap tiaagee baadh hai sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
verses.translation: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re sach milai bhau jai ||
verses.translation: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bin nirabhau kiau theeaai gurmukh sabadh samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ketaa aakhan aakheeaai aakhan toT na hoi ||
verses.translation: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

verses.original: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gan vaale ketaRe dhaataa eko soi ||
verses.translation: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis ke jeea paraan hai man vasiaai sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag supanaa baajee banee khin meh khel khelai ||
verses.translation: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jogee mil ekase vijogee uTh jai ||
verses.translation: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaanaa so theeaai avar na karanaa jai ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vasat vesaaheeaai sach vakhar sach raas ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa gur poore saabaas ||
verses.translation: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vasat pachhaanasee sach saudhaa jis paas ||4||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahal pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaat milai fun dhaat kau sifatee sifat samai ||
verses.translation: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

verses.original: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa ra(n)g chaRaau ||
verses.translation: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach milai sa(n)tokheeaa har jap ekai bhai ||1||
verses.translation: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re sa(n)t janaa kee ren ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa gur paieeaai mukat padhaarath dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: uoochau thaan suhaavanaa uoopar mahal muraar ||
verses.translation: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach karanee dhe paieeaai dhar ghar mahal piaar ||
verses.translation: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man samajhaieeaai aatam raam beechaar ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tirabidh karam kamaie'eeh aas a(n)dhesaa hoi ||
verses.translation: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau gur bin tirakuTee chhuTasee sahaj miliaai sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nij ghar mahal pachhaaneeaai nadhar kare mal dhoi ||3||
verses.translation: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiau ghar vaas ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: eko sabadh veechaareeaai avar tiaagai aas ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhekh dhikhaieeaai hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||4||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag jeevan dhohaaganee muThee dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kalar keree ka(n)dh jiau ahinis kir ddeh pai ||
verses.translation: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai sukh naa theeaai pir bin dhookh na jai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhe pir bin kiaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhar ghar ddoiee na lahai dharageh jhooTh khuaar ||1|| rahaau ||
