verses.translation: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap sujaan na bhuliee sachaa vadd kirasaan ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam dhe dhaan ||
verses.translation: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan ||2||
verses.translation: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kau jaan na jaaniee kiaa tis chaj achaar ||
verses.translation: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhulai naam visaariaa manmukh a(n)dh gubaar ||
verses.translation: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan na chukiee mar janamai hoi khuaar ||3||
verses.translation: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan mol anaiaa ku(n)goo maa(n)g sa(n)dhoor ||
verses.translation: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

verses.original: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: choaa cha(n)dhan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor ||
verses.translation: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

verses.original: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: je dhan ka(n)t na bhaaviee ta sabh adda(n)bar kooR ||4||
verses.translation: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ras bhogan baadh heh sabh seegaar vikaar ||
verses.translation: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag sabadh na bhedheeaai kiau sohai gurdhuaar ||
verses.translation: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dha(n)n suhaaganee jin seh naal piaar ||5||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n(j)ee dheh ddaraavanee jaa jeeau vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

verses.original: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaeh bala(n)dhee vijhavee dhooau na nikasio kai ||
verses.translation: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

verses.original: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)che ru(n)ne dhukh bhare binase dhoojai bhai ||1||
verses.translation: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mooRe raam japahu gun saar ||
verses.translation: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa mohanee sabh muThee aha(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa dhoojee kaarai lag ||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa laage pach mue a(n)tar tirasanaa ag ||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare hor muThee dha(n)dhai Thag ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: muiee pareet piaar giaa muaa vair virodh ||
verses.translation: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa thakaa hau muiee mamataa maiaa karodh ||
verses.translation: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam milai sach paieeaai gurmukh sadhaa nirodh ||3||
verses.translation: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee kaarai sach milai gurmat palai pai ||
verses.translation: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so nar ja(n)mai naa marai naa aavai naa jai ||
verses.translation: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhar paradhaan so dharageh paidhaa jai ||4||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tan jal bal maaTee bhiaa man maiaa moh manoor ||
verses.translation: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

verses.original: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaugan fir laagoo bhe koor vajaavai toor ||
verses.translation: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai bharamaieeaai dhubidhaa ddobe poor ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re sabadh tarahu chit lai ||
verses.translation: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh naam na boojhiaa mar janamai aavai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan soochaa so aakheeaai jis meh saachaa naau ||
verses.translation: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai sach raatee dhehuree jihavaa sach suaau ||
verses.translation: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sachee nadhar nihaaleeaai bahuR na paavai taau ||2||
verses.translation: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saache te pavanaa bhiaa pavanai te jal hoi ||
verses.translation: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jal te tirabhavan saajiaa ghaT ghaT jot samoi ||
verses.translation: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niramal mailaa naa theeaai sabadh rate pat hoi ||3||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih man saach sa(n)tokhiaa nadhar kare tis maeh ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bhoot sach bhai rate jot sachee man maeh ||
verses.translation: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak aaugan veesare gur raakhe pat taeh ||4||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak beRee sach kee tareeaai gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik aaveh ik jaavahee poor bhare aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manahaTh matee booddeeaai gurmukh sachu su taar ||1||
verses.translation: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin kiau tareeaai sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too mai avar na dhoojaa koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aagai dhekhau ddau jalai paachhai hario a(n)goor ||
verses.translation: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis te upajai tis te binasai ghaT ghaT sach bharapoor ||
verses.translation: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaavahee saachai mahal hadhoor ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: saeh saeh tujh sa(n)malaa kadhe na visaareau ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau saahab man vasai gurmukh a(n)mrit peau ||
verses.translation: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man tan teraa too dhanee garab nivaar sameau ||3||
verses.translation: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh jagat upaiaa tirabhavan kar aakaar ||
verses.translation: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chaanan jaaneeaai manmukh mugadh gubaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT jot nira(n)taree boojhai gurmat saar ||4||
verses.translation: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jinee jaaniaa tin keechai saabaas ||
verses.translation: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sache setee ral mile sache gun paragaas ||
verses.translation: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa jeeau pi(n)dd prabh paas ||5||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
verses.translit: sun man mitr piaariaa mil velaa hai eh ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ih tan dheh ||
verses.translation: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin gun kaam na aaviee ddeh dderee tan kheh ||1||
verses.translation: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man lai laahaa ghar jaeh ||
verses.translation: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam salaaheeaai haumai nivaree bhaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun ga(n)ddan ga(n)ddeeaai likh paR bujheh bhaar ||
verses.translation: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa ahinis agalee haumai rog vikaar ||
verses.translation: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oh veparavaahu atolavaa gurmat keemat saar ||2||
verses.translation: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh siaanap je karee lakh siau preet milaap ||
verses.translation: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin sa(n)gat saadh na dhraapeeaa bin naavai dhookh sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jap jeeare chhuTeeaai gurmukh cheenai aap ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan man gur peh vechiaa man dheeaa sir naal ||
verses.translation: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan khoj dda(n)ddoliaa gurmukh khoj nihaal ||
verses.translation: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: satagur mel milaiaa naanak so prabh naal ||4||17||
verses.translation: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: maranai kee chi(n)taa nahee jeevan kee nahee aas ||
verses.translation: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: too sarab jeeaa pratipaalahee lekhai saas giraas ||
verses.translation: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar gurmukh too vaseh jiau bhaavai tiau nirajaas ||1||
verses.translation: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeare raam japat man maan ||
verses.translation: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar laagee jal bujhee paiaa gurmukh giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee gat jaaneeaai gur mileeaai sa(n)k utaar ||
verses.translation: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

verses.original: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: muiaa jit ghar jaieeaai tit jeevadhiaa mar maar ||
verses.translation: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh suhaavane paieeaai gur veechaar ||2||
verses.translation: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh baanee paieeaai teh haumai hoi binaas ||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: satagur seve aapanaa hau sadh kurabaanai taas ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

verses.original: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khaR dharageh painaieeaai mukh har naam nivaas ||3||
verses.translation: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh rav rahe siv sakatee kaa mel ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: tirahu gun ba(n)dhee dhehuree jo aaiaa jag so khel ||
verses.translation: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

verses.original: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: vijogee dhukh vichhuRe manmukh laheh na mel ||4||
verses.translation: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man bairaagee ghar vasai sach bhai raataa hoi ||
verses.translation: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan mahaaras bhogavai baahuR bhookh na hoi ||
verses.translation: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak ih man maar mil bhee fir dhukh na hoi ||5||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh mano moorakh lobheeaa lobhe lagaa luobhaan ||
verses.translation: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh na bheejai saakataa dhuramat aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhoo satagur je milai taa paieeaai gunee nidhaan ||1||
verses.translation: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: man re haumai chhodd gumaan ||
verses.translation: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gur saravar sev too paaveh dharageh maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam jap dhinas raat gurmukh har dhan jaan ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sukh har ras bhogane sa(n)t sabhaa mil giaan ||
verses.translation: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nit ahinis har prabh seviaa satagur dheeaa naam ||2||
verses.translation: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kookar kooR kamaieeaai gur ni(n)dhaa pachai pachaan ||
verses.translation: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa dhukh ghano jam maar karai khulahaan ||
verses.translation: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh sukh na paieeaai gurmukh sukh subhaan ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai dha(n)dh piTaieeaai sach likhat paravaan ||
verses.translation: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har sajan gur sevadhaa gur karanee paradhaan ||
verses.translation: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai karam sachai neesaan ||4||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik til piaaraa veesarai rog vaddaa man maeh ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiau dharageh pat paieeaai jaa har na vasai man maeh ||
verses.translation: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai sukh paieeaai agan marai gun maeh ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man re ahinis har gun saar ||
verses.translation: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin khin pal naam na veesarai te jan virale sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milaieeaai suratee surat sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

verses.original: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)saa haumai gat ge naahee sahasaa sog ||
verses.translation: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jis har man vasai tis mele gur sa(n)jog ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kaaman je karee bhoge bhoganahaar ||
verses.translation: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau neh na keejiee jo dheesai chalanahaar ||
verses.translation: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raveh sohaaganee so prabh sej bhataar ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaare agan nivaar mar gurmukh har jal pai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kamal pragaasiaa a(n)mrit bhariaa aghai ||
verses.translation: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak satagur meet kar sach paaveh dharageh jai ||4||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har japahu piaariaa gurmat le har bol ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man sach kasavaTee laieeaai tuleeaai poorai tol ||
verses.translation: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: keemat kinai na paieeaai ridh maanak mol amol ||1||
verses.translation: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re har heeraa gur maeh ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat satagur paieeaai ahinis sabadh salaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sach vakhar dhan raas lai paieeaai gur paragaas ||
verses.translation: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau agan marai jal paiaai tiau tirasanaa dhaasan dhaas ||
verses.translation: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jam ja(n)dhaar na lagiee iau bhaujal tarai taraas ||2||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kooR na bhaaviee sach rate sach bhai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat sach na bhaaviee kooRai kooRee paa(n)i ||
verses.translation: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sach rate gur meliaai sache sach samai ||3||
verses.translation: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man meh maanak laal naam ratan padhaarath heer ||
verses.translation: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach vakhar dhan naam hai ghaT ghaT gahir ga(n)bheer ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paieeaai dhiaa kare har heer ||4||21||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhaeh na vijhavai je bhavai dhisa(n)tar dhes ||
verses.translation: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail na utarai dhirag jeevan dhirag ves ||
verses.translation: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hor kitai bhagat na hoviee bin satigur ke upadhes ||1||
verses.translation: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man re gurmukh agan nivaar ||
verses.translation: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa kahiaa man vasai haumai tirasanaa maar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man maanak niramol hai raam naam pat pai ||
verses.translation: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mil satasa(n)gat har paieeaai gurmukh har liv lai ||
verses.translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap giaa sukh paiaa mil salalai salal samai ||2||
verses.translation: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin har har naam na chetio su aaugun aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis satagur purakh na bheTio su bhaujal pachai pachai ||
verses.translation: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eih maanak jeeau niramol hai iau kauddee badhalai jai ||3||
verses.translation: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: ji(n)naa satagur ras milai se poore purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil bhaujal la(n)gheeaai dharageh pat paravaan ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak te mukh ujale dhun upajai sabadh neesaan ||4||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: vanaj karahu vanajaariho vakhar leh samaal ||
verses.translation: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.

verses.original: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: taisee vasat visaaheeaai jaisee nibahai naal ||
verses.translation: Buy that object which will go along with you.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: agai saahu sujaan hai laisee vasat samaal ||1||
verses.translation: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re raam kahahu chit lai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jas vakhar lai chalahu sahu dhekhai pateeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa raas na sach hai kiau tinaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

verses.original: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: khoTai vanaj vana(n)jiaai man tan khoTaa hoi ||
verses.translation: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

verses.original: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: faahee faathe mirag jiau dhookh ghano nit roi ||2||
verses.translation: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe potai naa paveh tin har gur dharas na hoi ||
verses.translation: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe jaat na pat hai khoT na seejhas koi ||
verses.translation: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khoTe khoT kamaavanaa aai giaa pat khoi ||3||
verses.translation: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: naanak man samajhaieeaai gur kai sabadh saalaeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ra(n)g ratiaa bhaar na bharam tinaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: har jap laahaa agalaa nirabhau har man maeh ||4||23||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhan joban ar fulaRaa naaTheeaRe dhin chaar ||
verses.translation: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

verses.original: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paban kere pat jiau ddal ddul ju(n)manahaar ||1||
verses.translation: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g maan lai piaariaa jaa joban nau hulaa ||
verses.translation: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhin thoRaRe thake bhiaa puraanaa cholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: sajan mere ra(n)gule jai sute jeeraan ||
verses.translation: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

verses.original: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ha(n) bhee va(n)n(j)aa ddumanee rovaa jheenee baan ||2||
verses.translation: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kee na sunehee gore'e aapan ka(n)nee soi ||
verses.translation: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

verses.original: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lagee aaveh saahurai nit na peieeaa hoi ||3||
verses.translation: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sutee peieeaai jaan viratee sa(n)n ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: gunaa gavaiee ga(n)ThaRee avagan chalee ba(n)n ||4||24||
verses.translation: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar dhoojaa 2 ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape raseeaa aap ras aape raavanahaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape hovai cholaRaa aape sej bhataar ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rataa meraa saahib rav rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape maachhee machhulee aape paanee jaal ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape jaal manakaRaa aape a(n)dhar laal ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape bahu bidh ra(n)gulaa sakhe'ee meraa laal ||
verses.translation: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nit ravai sohaaganee dhekh hamaaraa haal ||3||
verses.translation: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: pranavai naanak benatee too saravar too ha(n)s ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

verses.original: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: kaul too hai kaveeaa too hai aape vekh vigas ||4||25||
verses.translation: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan dharatee beej karamaa karo salil aapaau saari(n)gapaanee ||
verses.translation: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man kirasaan har ridhai ja(n)mai lai iau paavas padh nirabaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe garabas mooRe maiaa ||
verses.translation: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

verses.original: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pit suto sagal kaalatr maataa tere hoh na a(n)t sakhaiaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai bikaar dhusaT kirakhaa kare in taj aatamai hoi dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam hoh jab raakhe kamal bigasai madh aasramaiee ||2||
verses.translation: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bees sapataaharo baasaro sa(n)grahai teen khoRaa nit kaal saarai ||
verses.translation: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: dhas aThaar mai apara(n)paro cheenai kahai naanak iv ek taarai ||3||26||
verses.translation: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: amal kar dharatee beej sabadho kar sach kee aab nit dheh paanee ||
verses.translation: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi kirasaan ieemaan ja(n)mai lai bhisat dhojak mooRe ev jaanee ||1||
verses.translation: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣ ਸਹਿ ਗਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mat jaan seh galee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

verses.original: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maal kai maanai roop kee sobhaa it bidhee janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaib tan chikaRo ih man meeddako kamal kee saar nahee mool paiee ||
verses.translation: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

verses.original: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaur usataadh nit bhaakhiaa bole kiau boojhai jaa neh bujhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

verses.original: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan sunanaa paun kee baanee ih man rataa maiaa ||
verses.translation: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khasam kee nadhar dhileh pasi(n)dhe jinee kar ek dhiaaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teeh kar rakhe pa(n)j kar saathee naau saitaan mat kaT jaiee ||
verses.translation: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai raeh pai chalanaa maal dhan kit koo sa(n)jiaahee ||4||27||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: soiee maulaa jin jag mauliaa hariaa keeaa sa(n)saaro ||
verses.translation: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

verses.original: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aab khaak jin ba(n)dh rahaiee dha(n)n sirajanahaaro ||1||
verses.translation: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||

verses.original: ਮਰਣਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: maranaa mulaa maranaa ||
verses.translation: Death, O Mullah-death will come,

verses.original: ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਹੁ ਡਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhee karataarahu ddaranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa too mulaa taa too kaajee jaaneh naam khudhaiee ||
verses.translation: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je bahuteraa paRiaa hoveh ko rahai na bhareeaai paiee ||2||
verses.translation: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: soiee kaajee jin aap tajiaa ik naam keeaa aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

verses.original: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee sachaa sirajanahaaro ||3||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)j vakhat nivaaj gujaareh paReh kateb kuraanaa ||
verses.translation: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai gor sadheiee rahio peenaa khaanaa ||4||28||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸੁਆਨੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek suaan dhui suaanee naal ||
verses.translation: The dogs of greed are with me.

verses.original: ਭਲਕੇ ਭਉਕਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਇਆਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhalake bhaukeh sadhaa biaal ||
verses.translation: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੁਰਾ ਮੁਠਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooR chhuraa muThaa muradhaar ||
verses.translation: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.

verses.original: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||1||
verses.translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: mai pat kee pa(n)dh na karanee kee kaar ||
verses.translation: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਿਗੜੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: hau bigaRai roop rahaa bikaraal ||
verses.translation: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: teraa ek naam taare sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai ehaa aas eho aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਆਖਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mukh ni(n)dhaa aakhaa dhin raat ||
verses.translation: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: par ghar johee neech sanaat ||
verses.translation: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh tan vaseh cha(n)ddaal ||
verses.translation: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.

verses.original: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||2||
verses.translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||

verses.original: ਫਾਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਲੂਕੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: faahee surat malookee ves ||
verses.translation: I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਠਗਵਾੜਾ ਠਗੀ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau ThagavaaRaa Thagee dhes ||
verses.translation: I am a robber-I rob the world.

verses.original: ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kharaa siaanaa bahutaa bhaar ||
verses.translation: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.

verses.original: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||3||
verses.translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai keetaa na jaataa haraamakhor ||
verses.translation: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau kiaa muh dhesaa dhusaT chor ||
verses.translation: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak neech kahai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.

verses.original: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar ||4||29||
verses.translation: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa surat jete hai jeea ||
verses.translation: There is one awareness among all created beings.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਅ ॥
verses.translit: surat vihoonaa koi na keea ||
verses.translation: None have been created without this awareness.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jehee surat tehaa tin raahu ||
verses.translation: As is their awareness, so is their way.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lekhaa iko aavahu jaahu ||1||
verses.translation: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe jeea kareh chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?

verses.original: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: levai dhevai ddil na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tere jeea jeeaa kaa toh ||
verses.translation: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,

verses.original: ਕਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kit kau saahib aaveh roh ||
verses.translation: how can You become angry with them?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: je too saahib aaveh roh ||
verses.translation: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,

verses.original: ਤੂ ਓਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਓਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too onaa kaa tere oh ||2||
verses.translation: still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਸੀ ਬੋਲਵਿਗਾੜ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: asee bolavigaaR vigaaReh bol ||
verses.translation: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: too nadharee a(n)dhar toleh tol ||
verses.translation: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh karanee teh pooree mat ||
verses.translation: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karanee baajhahu ghaTe ghaT ||3||
verses.translation: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak giaanee kaisaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaanai boojhai soi ||
verses.translation: They are self-realized; they understand God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: so giaanee dharageh paravaan ||4||30||
verses.translation: such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: too dhareeaau dhaanaa beenaa mai machhulee kaise a(n)t lahaa ||
verses.translation: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh teh too hai tujh te nikasee fooT maraa ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||

verses.original: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: n jaanaa meau na jaanaa jaalee ||
verses.translation: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa dhukh laagai taa tujhai samaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: too bharapoor jaaniaa mai dhoor ||
verses.translation: You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo kachh karee su terai hadhoor ||
verses.translation: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too dhekheh hau mukar paau ||
verses.translation: You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: terai ka(n)m na terai nai ||2||
verses.translation: I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਹਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa dheh tetaa hau khaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.

verses.original: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: biaa dhar naahee kai dhar jaau ||
verses.translation: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ek kahai aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this one prayer:

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh terai paas ||3||
verses.translation: this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape neRai dhoor aape hee aape ma(n)jh miaanuo ||
verses.translation: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai sune aape hee kudharat kare jahaanuo ||
verses.translation: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa hukam soiee paravaanuo ||4||31||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa kahaa kare man maan ||
verses.translation: Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaare kai hath dhaan ||
verses.translation: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaavai dhei na dheiee soi ||
verses.translation: As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.

verses.original: ਕੀਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: keete kai kahiaai kiaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sach bhaavai tis sach ||
verses.translation: He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa kachaa kach nikach ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਆਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke rukh birakh aaraau ||
verses.translation: The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jehee dhaat tehaa tin naau ||
verses.translation: according to their nature, He gives them all their names.

verses.original: ਫੁਲੁ ਭਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ful bhaau fal likhiaa pai ||
verses.translation: The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap beej aape hee khai ||2||
verses.translation: As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਚੀ ਕੰਧ ਕਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: kachee ka(n)dh kachaa vich raaj ||
verses.translation: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: mat aloonee fikaa saadh ||
verses.translation: The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਣੇ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aane aavai raas ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.

verses.translit: vin naavai naahee saabaas ||3||32||
verses.translation: Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fifth House:

verses.original: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: achhal chhalaiee neh chhalai neh ghaau kaTaaraa kar sakai ||
verses.translation: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau saahib raakhai tiau rahai is lobhee kaa jeeau Tal palai ||1||
verses.translation: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin tel dheevaa kiau jalai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥ ਭਉ ਵਟੀ ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: pothee puraan kamaieeaai || bhau vaTee it tan paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil, and let the Fear of God be the wick for the lamp of this body.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਆਣਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach boojhan aan jalaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਇਉ ਜਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih tel dheevaa iau jalai ||
verses.translation: Use this oil to light this lamp.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar chaanan saahib tau milai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: eit tan laagai baaneeaa ||
verses.translation: This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukh hovai sev kamaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh dhuneeaa aavan jaaneeaa ||3||
verses.translation: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vich dhuneeaa sev kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: In the midst of this world, do seva,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: taa dharageh baisan paieeaai ||
verses.translation: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak baeh luddaieeaai ||4||33||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau satigur sevee aapanaa ik man ik chit bhai ||
verses.translation: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur man kaamanaa teerath hai jis no dhei bujhai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa var paavanaa jo ichhai so fal pai ||
verses.translation: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naau dhiaaieeaai naau ma(n)geeaai naame sahaj samai ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har ras chaakh tikh jai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gurmukh chaakhiaa sahaje rahe samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee satigur seviaa tinee paiaa naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar har ras rav rahiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kamal pragaasiaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man niramal har rav rahiaa paiaa dharageh maan ||2||
verses.translation: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevan aapanaa te virale sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa maar kai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinaa naame lagaa piaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: seiee sukhe'ee chahu jugee jinaa naam akhuT apaar ||3||
verses.translation: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai naam paieeaai chookai moh piaas ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: har setee man rav rahiaa ghar hee maeh udhaas ||
verses.translation: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa har kaa saadh aaiaa hau tin balihaarai jaas ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai sach naam gunataas ||4||1||34||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bhekh kar bharamaieeaai man hiradhai kapaT kamai ||
verses.translation: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kaa mahal na paaviee mar visaTaa maeh samai ||1||
verses.translation: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: man re gireh hee maeh udhaas ||
verses.translation: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam karanee so kare gurmukh hoi paragaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh man jeetiaa gat mukat gharai meh pai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam dhiaaieeaai satasa(n)gat mel milai ||2||
verses.translation: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: je lakh isatareeaa bhog kareh nav kha(n)dd raaj kamaeh ||
verses.translation: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sukh na paaviee fir fir jonee paeh ||3||
verses.translation: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har haar ka(n)Th jinee pahiriaa gur charanee chit lai ||
verses.translation: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tinaa pichhai ridh sidh firai onaa til na tamai ||4||
verses.translation: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo prabh bhaavai so theeaai avar na karanaa jai ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak jeevai naam lai har dhevahu sahaj subhai ||5||2||35||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis hee kee sirakaar hai tis hee kaa sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kaar kamaavanee sach ghaT paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jis kai sach vasai sache sachee soi ||
verses.translation: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach mile se na vichhuReh tin nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam mai har bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satagur sach prabh niramalaa sabadh milaavaa hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh milai so mil rahai jis nau aape le milai ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai ko naa milai fir fir aavai jai ||
verses.translation: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh ik varatadhaa eko rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis nau aap dhiaal hoi so gurmukh naam samai ||2||
verses.translation: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit jotakee vaadh kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mat budh bhavee na bujhiee a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
verses.translation: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh bharamadhe bhram bhram hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satagur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir dheejai aap gavai ||
verses.translation: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh mileh taa har milai sevaa pavai sabh thai ||
verses.translation: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paaras parasiaai paaras hoi jotee jot samai ||
verses.translation: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satagur miliaa aai ||4||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: man bhukhaa bhukhaa mat kareh mat too kareh pookaar ||
verses.translation: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jin siree sabhasai dhei adhaar ||
verses.translation: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau sadhaa dhiaal hai sabhanaa karadhaa saar ||
verses.translation: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh bujheeaai paieeaai mokh dhuaar ||5||3||36||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sun kai ma(n)niaa tinaa nij ghar vaas ||
verses.translation: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee saalaeh sach har paiaa gunataas ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate se niramale hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.
