verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hiradhai jin kai har vasai tit ghaT hai paragaas ||1||
verses.translation: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har har niramal dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa se gurmukh rahe liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)tahu dhekhahu nadhar kar nikaT vasai bharapoor ||
verses.translation: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat jinee pachhaaniaa se dhekheh sadhaa hadhoor ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin gun tin sadh man vasai aaugunava(n)tiaa dhoor ||
verses.translation: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh gun tai baahare bin naavai maradhe jhoor ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin sabadh guroo sun ma(n)niaa tin man dhiaaiaa har soi ||
verses.translation: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagatee ratiaa man tan niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooRaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa binas jai dhukh roi ||
verses.translation: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)dhar naam pragaas hai oh sadhaa sadhaa thir hoi ||3||
verses.translation: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih janam padhaarath pai kai har naam na chetai liv lai ||
verses.translation: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pag khisiaai rahanaa nahee aagai Thaur na pai ||
verses.translation: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh velaa hath na aaviee a(n)t giaa pachhutai ||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis nadhar kare so ubarai har setee liv lai ||4||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhaa dhekhee sabh kare manmukh boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh hiradhaa sudh hai sev piee tin thai ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaaveh har nit paReh har gun gai samai ||
verses.translation: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kee baanee sadhaa sach hai j naam rahe liv lai ||5||4||37||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee ik man naam dhiaaiaa gurmatee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke mukh sadh ujale tit sachai dharabaar ||
verses.translation: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oi a(n)mrit peeveh sadhaa sadhaa sachai naam piaar ||1||
verses.translation: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gurmukh sadhaa pat hoi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har sadhaa dhiaaieeaai mal haumai kaddai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh naam na jaananee vin naavai pat jai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na aaio laage dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: visaTaa ke keeRe paveh vich visaTaa se visaTaa maeh samai ||2||
verses.translation: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa janam safal hai jo chaleh satagur bhai ||
verses.translation: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kul udhaareh aapanaa dha(n)n janedhee mai ||
verses.translation: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaaieeaai jis nau kirapaa kare rajai ||3||
verses.translation: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oi a(n)dharahu baaharahu niramale sache sach samai ||
verses.translation: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: naanak aae se paravaan heh jin gurmatee har dhiaai ||4||5||38||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa har dhan raas hai gur poochh kareh vaapaar ||
verses.translation: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam salaahan sadhaa sadhaa vakhar har naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai har naam dhiraRaiaa har bhagataa atuT bha(n)ddaar ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re is man kau samajhai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e man aalas kiaa kareh gurmukh naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagat har kaa piaar hai je gurmukh kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd bhagat na hoviee dhubidhaa bol khuaar ||
verses.translation: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so jan ralaiaa naa ralai jis a(n)tar bibek beechaar ||2||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so sevak har aakheeaai jo har raakhai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan saupe aagai dhare haumai vichahu maar ||
verses.translation: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhan gurmukh so paravaan hai j kadhe na aavai haar ||3||
verses.translation: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karam milai taa paieeaai vin karamai paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh tarasadhe jis mele so milai har aai ||
verses.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har paiaa sadhaa har naam samai ||4||6||39||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar har naam hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam dhiaaieeaai sahaje naam samai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar rachai har sach siau rasanaa har gun gai ||1||
verses.translation: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re jag dhukheeaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur saranaiee sukh laheh anadhin naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: saache mail na laagiee man niramal har dhiaai ||
verses.translation: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh pachhaaneeaai har a(n)mirat naam samai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur giaan pracha(n)dd balaiaa agiaan a(n)dheraa jai ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh maile mal bhare haumai tirasanaa vikaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai mail na utarai mar ja(n)meh hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.

verses.original: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhaatur baajee palach rahe naa uravaar na paar ||3||
verses.translation: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jap tap sa(n)jamee har kai naam piaar ||
verses.translation: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa dhiaaieeaai ek naam karataar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||4||7||40||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh moh viaapiaa bairaag udhaasee na hoi ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh na cheenai sadhaa dhukh har dharageh pat khoi ||
verses.translation: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haumai gurmukh khoieeaai naam rate sukh hoi ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man ahinis poor rahee nit aasaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satagur sev moh parajalai ghar hee maeh udhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh karam kamaavai bigasai har bairaag ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis bhagat kare dhin raatee haumai maar nicha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag satasa(n)gat paiee har paiaa sahaj ana(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: so saadhoo bairaagee soiee hiradhai naam vasaae ||
verses.translation: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar laag na taamas moole vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan sataguroo dhikhaaliaa har ras peeaa aghaae ||3||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin kinai paiaa saadhasa(n)gatee poorai bhaag bairaag ||
verses.translation: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh fireh na jaaneh satagur haumai a(n)dhar laag ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh rate har naam ra(n)gaae bin bhai kehee laag ||4||8||41||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee saudhaa paieeaai a(n)tar sabh vath hoi ||
verses.translation: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: khin khin naam samaaleeaai gurmukh paavai koi ||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan akhuT hai vaddabhaag paraapat hoi ||1||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man taj ni(n)dhaa haumai aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sadhaa dhiaai too gurmukh eka(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa ke mukh ujale gur sabadhee beechaar ||
verses.translation: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat sukh paidhe jap jap ridhai muraar ||
verses.translation: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghar hee vich mahal paiaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||2||
verses.translation: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: satagur te jo muh fereh mathe tin kaale ||
verses.translation: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin dhukh kamaavadhe nit johe jam jaale ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: supanai sukh na dhekhanee bahu chi(n)taa parajaale ||3||
verses.translation: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa dhaataa ek hai aape bakhas karei ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.

verses.original: ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahanaa kichhoo na jaaviee jis bhaavai tis dhei ||
verses.translation: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paieeaai aape jaanai soi ||4||9||42||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib seveeaai sach vaddiaaiee dhei ||
verses.translation: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man vasai haumai dhoor karei ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eih man dhaavat taa rahai jaa aape nadhar karei ||1||
verses.translation: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gurmukh har naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan sadh man vasai mahalee paavai thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh man tan a(n)dh hai tis nau Thaur na Thaau ||
verses.translation: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahu jonee bhaudhaa firai jiau su(n)n(j)ai(n) ghar kaau ||
verses.translation: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa sabadh milai har naau ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun bikhiaa a(n)dh hai maiaa moh gubaar ||
verses.translation: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.

verses.original: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: lobhee an kau sevadhe paR vedhaa karai pookaar ||
verses.translation: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa a(n)dhar pach mue naa uravaar na paar ||3||
verses.translation: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh visaariaa jagat pitaa pratipaal ||
verses.translation: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.

verses.original: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: baajhahu guroo achet hai sabh badhee jamakaal ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmat ubare sachaa naam samaal ||4||10||43||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa moh hai gurmukh chauthaa padh pai ||
verses.translation: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa melaian har naam vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.

verses.original: ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: potai jin kai pu(n)n hai tin satasa(n)gat melai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gurmat saach rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saacho saach kamaavanaa saachai sabadh milaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee naam pachhaaniaa tin viTahu bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd charanee lagaa chalaa tin kai bhai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laahaa har har naam milai sahaje naam samai ||2||
verses.translation: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur mahal na paieeaai naam na paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satagur loR lahu jidhoo paieeaai sach soi ||
verses.translation: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: asur sa(n)ghaarai sukh vasai jo tis bhaavai su hoi ||3||
verses.translation: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa satagur kar jaaniaa teho jehaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh sahasaa moole naahee bhaau laae jan koi ||
verses.translation: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ek jot dhui mooratee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||4||11||44||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਾਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit chhodd bikhiaa lobhaane sevaa kareh viddaanee ||
verses.translation: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa dharam gavaaveh boojheh naahee anadhin dhukh vihaanee ||
verses.translation: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dh na chetahee ddoob mue bin paanee ||1||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man re sadhaa bhajahu har saranaiee ||
verses.translation: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh a(n)tar vasai taa har visar na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eih sareer maiaa kaa putalaa vich haumai dhusaTee paiee ||
verses.translation: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa ja(n)man maranaa manmukh pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satagur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa jotee jot milaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satagur kee sevaa at sukhaalee jo ichhe so fal paae ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat tap pavit sareeraa har har ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee mil preetam sukh paae ||3||
verses.translation: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo satagur kee saranaagatee hau tin kai bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhar sachai sachee vaddiaaiee sahaje sach samaau ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai gurmukh mel milaau ||4||12||45||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kamaavane jiau dhohaagan tan seegaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.

verses.original: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sejai ka(n)t na aaviee nit nit hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pir kaa mahal na paaviee naa dheesai ghar baar ||1||
verses.translation: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re ik man naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat mil rahai jap raam naam sukh pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa sohaaganee pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa boleh niv chaleh sejai ravai bhataar ||
verses.translation: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sobhaava(n)tee sohaaganee jin gur kaa het apaar ||2||
verses.translation: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satagur milai jaa bhaagai kaa udhau hoi ||
verses.translation: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarahu dhukh bhram kaTeeaai sukh paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai dhukh na paavai koi ||3||
verses.translation: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke bhaane vich a(n)mrit hai sahaje paavai koi ||
verses.translation: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa paraapat tin peeaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
verses.translation: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai sach milaavaa hoi ||4||13||46||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa pir jaanai aapanaa tan man agai dharei ||
verses.translation: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.

verses.original: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sohaaganee karam kamaavadheeaa seiee karam karei ||
verses.translation: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaje saach milaavaRaa saach vaddaiee dhei ||1||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gur bin bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur bhagat na paieeaai je lochai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh fer piaa kaaman dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur needh na aaviee dhukhee rain vihai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai pir na paieeaai birathaa janam gavai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karatee jag firee naa dhan sa(n)pai naal ||
verses.translation: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhee naam na chetiee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
verses.translation: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satagur miliaai dhan paiaa har naamaa ridhai samaal ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate se niramale gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan raataa ra(n)g siau rasanaa rasan rasai ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: naanak ra(n)g na utarai jo har dhur chhoddiaa lai ||4||14||47||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kirapaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai soiee ||
verses.translation: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jeeau saachaa saachee baanee sabadh milaavaa hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape jagajeevan sukhadhaataa aape bakhas milaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
verses.translation: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aape dhei vaddaiee aape sev karaae ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh kuTa(n)b moh lobhaanaa chaladhiaa naal na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satagur sev gun nidhaan paiaa tis dhee keem na paiee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har prabh sakhaa meet prabh meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau dhaataa bhagat vachhal hai kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sobhaa surat dhei prabh aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee ||4||15||48||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhan jananee jin jaiaa dha(n)n pitaa paradhaan || satagur sev sukh paiaa vichahu giaa gumaan ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace. His arrogant pride is banished from within.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhar sevan sa(n)t jan khaRe pain gunee nidhaan ||1||
verses.translation: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur mukh dhiaai har soi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh man vasai man tan niramal hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa aape miliaa aai ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee saalaaheeaai ra(n)ge sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sachai sach samaiaa mil rahai na vichhuR jai ||2||
verses.translation: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jai ||
verses.translation: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.

verses.original: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chiree vichhu(n)ne melian satagur pa(n)nai pai ||
verses.translation: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape kaar karaisee avar na karanaa jai ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rataa ra(n)g siau haumai taj vikaar ||
verses.translation: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis hiradhai rav rahai nirabhau naam nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: naanak aap milaian poorai sabadh apaar ||4||16||49||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: govidh gunee nidhaan hai a(n)t na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee na paieeaai haumai vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satagur miliaai sadh bhai rachai aap vasai man aai ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gurmukh boojhai koi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe karam kamaavane janam padhaarath khoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee chaakhiaa tinee saadh paiaa bin chaakhe bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit saachaa naam hai kahanaa kachhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.

verses.original: ਪੀਵਤ ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: peevat hoo paravaan bhiaa poorai sabadh samai ||2||
verses.translation: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhei ta paieeaai hor karanaa kichhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhevan vaale kai hath dhaat hai guroo dhuaarai pai ||
verses.translation: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jehaa keeton tehaa hoaa jehe karam kamai ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam naam hai vin naavai niramal na hoi ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag naam man vasai sabadh milaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje hee ra(n)g varatadhaa har gun paavai soi ||4||17||50||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)iaa saadhai uradh tap karai vichahu haumai na jai ||
verses.translation: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.

verses.original: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: adhiaatam karam je kare naam na kab hee pai ||
verses.translation: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh jeevat marai har naam vasai man aai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun man mere bhaj satagur saranaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee chhuTeeaai bikh bhavajal sabadh gur taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai dhoojaa bhaau vikaar ||
verses.translation: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paRai ba(n)dhan moh baadhaa neh boojhai bikhiaa piaar ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satagur miliaai tirakuTee chhooTai chauthai padh mukat dhuaar ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur te maarag paieeaai chookai moh gubaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai taa udharai paae mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee mil rahai sach naam karataar ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa at sabal hai chhadde na kitai upai ||
verses.translation: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai dhukh laidhaa bahutee dhei sajai ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam lage se ubare haumai sabadh gavai ||4||18||51||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare gur paieeaai har naamo dhei dhiraRai ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur kinai na paio birathaa janam gavai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kamaavane dharageh milai sajai ||1||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re dhoojaa bhaau chukai ||
verses.translation: O mind, give up the love of duality.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar terai har vasai gur sevaa sukh pai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach baanee sach sabadh hai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam man vasai haumai karodh nivaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man niramal naam dhiaaieeaai taa paae mokh dhuaar ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਦਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich jag binasadhaa mar ja(n)mai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sabadh na jaananee jaasan pat gavai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa naau paieeaai sache rahai samai ||3||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ma(n)niaai gur paieeaai vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kare sadhaa saache kee liv lai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath man vasiaa naanak sahaj samai ||4||19||52||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dhukhe'ee jug chaar ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hodhaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan muThe aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sataguroo kiaa fiTakiaa ma(n)g thake sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh na sevio sabh kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||
verses.translation: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere sadhaa har vekh hadhoor ||
verses.translation: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh paraharai sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach salaahan se sache sachaa naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachee kaar kamaavanee sache naal piaar ||
verses.translation: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahu varatadhaa koi na meTanahaar ||
verses.translation: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: manmukh mahal na painee kooR muThe kooRiaar ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai karataa jag muaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh visaariaa sukhadhaataa dhaataar ||
verses.translation: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satagur seveh taa ubareh sach rakheh ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kirapaa te har paieeaai sach sabadh veechaar ||3||
verses.translation: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: satagur sev man niramalaa haumai taj vikaar ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd jeevat marai gur kai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat reh ge laagaa saach piaar ||
verses.translation: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sach rate mukh ujale tit saachai dharabaar ||4||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satagur purakh na ma(n)nio sabadh na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

verses.original: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eisanaan dhaan jetaa kareh dhoojai bhai khuaar ||
verses.translation: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aapanee kirapaa kare taa laagai naam piaar ||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal too gur kai het apaar ||5||20||53||
verses.translation: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kis hau sevee kiaa jap karee satagur poochhau jai ||
verses.translation: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satagur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n liee vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: ehaa sevaa chaakaree naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naamai hee te sukh paieeaai sachai sabadh suhai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere anadhin jaag har chet ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee khetee rakh lai koo(n)j paRaigee khet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhai bhagat kareh dhin raatee har jeeau vekhai sadhaa hadhoor ||
verses.translation: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sadhaa man raataa bhram giaa sareerahu dhoor ||
verses.translation: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: niramal saahib paiaa saachaa gunee gaheer ||2||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jaage se ubare soote ge muhai ||
verses.translation: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh na pachhaanio supanaa giaa vihai ||
verses.translation: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n(j)e ghar kaa paahunaa jiau aaiaa tiau jai ||
verses.translation: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh janam birathaa giaa kiaa muh dhesee jai ||3||
verses.translation: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap hai haumai vich kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh pachhaaneeaai dhukh haumai vichahu gavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satagur sevan aapanaa hau tin kai laagau pai ||
verses.translation: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: naanak dhar sachai sachiaar heh hau tin balihaarai jaau ||4||21||54||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je velaa vakhat veechaareeaai taa kit velaa bhagat hoi ||
verses.translation: If we keep contemplating about the time as to when to remember the Lord, then when will we find the actual time for worship?

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naame ratiaa sache sachee soi ||
verses.translation: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik til piaaraa visarai bhagat kinehee hoi ||
verses.translation: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal saach siau saas na birathaa koi ||1||
verses.translation: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har kaa naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachee bhagat taa theeaai jaa har vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje khetee raaheeaai sach naam beej pai ||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.

verses.original: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khetee ja(n)mee agalee manooaa rajaa sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mrit hai jit peetai tikh jai ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eih man saachaa sach rataa sache rahiaa samai ||2||
verses.translation: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan vekhan bolanaa sabadhe rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baanee vajee chahu jugee sacho sach sunai ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa reh giaa sachai liaa milai ||
verses.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin kau mahal hadhoor hai jo sach rahe liv lai ||3||
verses.translation: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee naam dhiaaieeaai vin karamaa paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satasa(n)gat lahai satagur bheTai jis aai ||
verses.translation: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naame ratiaa dhukh bikhiaa vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh milaavaRaa naame naam samai ||4||22||55||
verses.translation: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa bhau tin paion jin gur kaa sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gatee sadhaa mil rahe sache ke gun saar ||
verses.translation: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa mail chukaieean har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee sach man sache naal piaar ||1||
verses.translation: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere haumai mail bhar naal ||
verses.translation: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har niramal sadhaa sohanaa sabadh savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh man mohiaa prabh aape le milai ||
verses.translation: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naame ratiaa jotee jot samai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jotee hoo prabh jaapadhaa bin satagur boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa satagur bheTiaa tin aai ||2||
verses.translation: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai sabh ddumanee dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin ghaRee na jeevadhee dhukhee rain vihai ||
verses.translation: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaanaa a(n)dhulaa fir fir aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare prabh aapanee aape le milai ||3||
verses.translation: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh sunadhaa vekhadhaa kiau mukar piaa jai ||
verses.translation: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?

verses.original: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paapo paap kamaavadhe paape pacheh pachai ||
verses.translation: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh nadhar na aaviee manmukh boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: jis vekhaale soiee vekhai naanak gurmukh pai ||4||23||56||
verses.translation: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur rog na tuTiee haumai peeR na jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the disease is not cured, and the pain of egotism is not removed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man vasai naame rahai samai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He dwells in the mind, and one remains immersed in His Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee har paieeaai bin sabadhai bharam bhulai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found; without the Shabad, people wander, deceived by doubt. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O mind, dwell in the balanced state of your own inner being.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam saalaeh too fir aavan jaan na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Praise the Lord's Name, and you shall no longer come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har iko dhaataa varatadhaa dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The One Lord alone is the Giver, pervading everywhere. There is no other at all.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh saalaahee man vasai sahaje hee sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Praise the Word of the Shabad, and He shall come to dwell in your mind; you shall be blessed with intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh nadharee a(n)dhar vekhadhaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||2||
verses.translation: Everything is within the Lord's Glance of Grace. As He wishes, He gives. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਾ ਗਣਤ ਹੈ ਗਣਤੈ ਨਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai sabhaa ganat hai ganatai nau sukh naeh ||
verses.translation: In egotism, all must account for their actions. In this accounting, there is no peace.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bikh kee kaar kamaavanee bikh hee maeh samaeh ||
verses.translation: Acting in evil and corruption, people are immersed in corruption.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin naavai Thaur na painee jamapur dhookh sahaeh ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they find no place of rest. In the City of Death, they suffer in agony. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa tisai dhaa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Body and soul all belong to Him; He is the Support of all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bujheeaai taa paae mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, understanding comes, and then the Door of Liberation is found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh too(n) a(n)t na paaraavaar ||4||24||57||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has no end or limitation. ||4||24||57||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tinaa ana(n)dh sadhaa sukh hai jinaa sach naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who have the Support of the True Name are in ecstasy and peace forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee sach paiaa dhookh nivaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they obtain the True One, the Destroyer of pain.
