verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa saache gun gaaveh saachai nai piaar ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the True Name.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kar kai aapanee dhiton bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||1||
verses.translation: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, He bestows the treasure of devotion. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re sadhaa ana(n)dh gun gai ||
verses.translation: O mind, sing His Glorious Praises, and be in ecstasy forever.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee har paieeaai har siau rahai samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of His Bani, the Lord is obtained, and one remains immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagatee man laal theeaa rataa sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: In true devotion, the mind is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love, with intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee man mohiaa kahanaa kachhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: The mind is fascinated by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, which cannot be described.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa ratee sabadh sachai a(n)mrit peevai ras gun gai ||
verses.translation: The tongue imbued with the True Word of the Shabad drinks in the Amrit with delight, singing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh eh ra(n)g paieeaai jis no kirapaa kare rajai ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains this love, when the Lord, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saa ih sa(n)saar hai sutiaa rain vihai ||
verses.translation: This world is an illusion; people pass their life-nights sleeping.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik aapanai bhaanai kadd lian aape lion milai ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, He lifts some out, and unites them with Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee aap man vasiaa maiaa moh chukai ||
verses.translation: He Himself abides in the mind, and drives out attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap vaddaiee dhiteean gurmukh dhei bujhai ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself bestows glorious greatness; He inspires the Gurmukh to understand. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਲਏ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa dhaataa ek hai bhuliaa le samajhai ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all. He corrects those who make mistakes.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਛਡਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape aap khuaaian dhoojai chhaddian lai ||
verses.translation: He Himself has deceived some, and attached them to duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee har paieeaai jotee jot milai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is found, and one's light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: anadhin naame ratiaa naanak naam samai ||4||25||58||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Name of the Lord night and day, O Nanak, you shall be absorbed into the Name. ||4||25||58||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee sach paiaa tirasanaa taj vikaar ||
verses.translation: The virtuous obtain Truth; they give up their desires for evil and corruption.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee man ra(n)giaa rasanaa prem piaar ||
verses.translation: Their minds are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Love of their Beloved is on their tongues.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kinai na paio kar vekhahu man veechaar ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh mail na utarai jichar gur sabadh na kare piaar ||1||
verses.translation: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere satigur kai bhaanai chal ||
verses.translation: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaseh a(n)mrit peeveh taa sukh laheh mahal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaugunava(n)tee gun ko nahee bahan na milai hadhoor ||
verses.translation: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sabadh na jaaniee avagan so prabh dhoor ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach rate bharapoor ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee man bedhiaa prabh miliaa aap hadhoor ||2||
verses.translation: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himself ushers them into His Presence. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗਣਿ ਰੰਗਿਓਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape ra(n)gan ra(n)gion sabadhe lion milai ||
verses.translation: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, He unites us with Himself.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa ra(n)g na utarai jo sach rate liv lai ||
verses.translation: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa bhav thake manmukh boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, but they do not understand.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis satigur mele so milai sachai sabadh samai ||3||
verses.translation: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mitr ghanere kar thakee meraa dhukh kaaTai koi ||
verses.translation: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be able to end my suffering.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam dhukh kaTiaa sabadh milaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach khaTanaa sach raas hai sache sachee soi ||
verses.translation: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains a reputation of Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: sach mile se na vichhuReh naanak gurmukh hoi ||4||26||59||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Him again. ||4||26||59||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape kaaran karataa kare sirasaT dhekhai aap upai ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himself watches over it.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh eko ik varatadhaa alakh na lakhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape prabhoo dhiaal hai aape dhei bujhai ||
verses.translation: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sadh man vasiaa sach rahe liv lai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those who remain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gur kee ma(n)n lai rajai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal sabh theeaai naam vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa soiee saar karei ||
verses.translation: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh pachhaaneeaai jaa aape nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: se jan sabadhe sohane tit sachai dharabaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sachai sabadh rate aap mele karataar ||2||
verses.translation: -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unites them with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sach salaahanaa jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT aape hukam vasai hukame kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, we contemplate Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee saalaaheeaai haumai vichahu khoi ||
verses.translation: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism from within.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saa dhan naavai baaharee avaganava(n)tee roi ||3||
verses.translation: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach salaahee sach lagaa sachai nai tirapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun veechaaree gun sa(n)grahaa avagun kaddaa dhoi ||
verses.translation: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean of demerits.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaidhaa fir vechhoRaa na hoi ||
verses.translation: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: naanak gur saalaahee aapanaa jidhoo paiee prabh soi ||4||27||60||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਾਮ ਗਹੇਲੀਏ ਕਿਆ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun kaam gahele'ee kiaa chaleh baeh luddai ||
verses.translation: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk like that, swinging your arms in joy?

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa pir na pachhaanahee kiaa muh dheseh jai ||
verses.translation: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face will you show Him?

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖਂੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sakha(n)ee ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin kai laagau pai ||
verses.translation: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa satasa(n)gat mel milai ||1||
verses.translation: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhe kooR muThee kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pir prabh saachaa sohanaa paieeaai gur beechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ka(n)t na pachhaaniee tin kiau rain vihai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spend their life-night?

verses.original: ਗਰਬਿ ਅਟੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: garab aTeeaa tirasanaa jaleh dhukh paaveh dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love of duality.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rateeaa sohaaganee tin vichahu haumai jai ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated from within.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa pir raaveh aapanaa tinaa sukhe sukh vihai ||2||
verses.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissful peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan vihoonee pir muteeaa piram na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan matee a(n)dher hai bin pir dhekhe bhukh na jai ||
verses.translation: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and her hunger does not depart.

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu milahu saheleeho mai pir dheh milai ||
verses.translation: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satigur milai pir paiaa sach samai ||3||
verses.translation: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she is absorbed in the True One. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: se saheeaa sohaaganee jin kau nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasam pachhaaneh aapanaa tan man aagai dhei ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering before Him.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar var paiaa aapanaa haumai dhoor karei ||
verses.translation: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sobhaava(n)teeaa sohaaganee anadhin bhagat karei ||4||28||61||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they are absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik pir raaveh aapanaa hau kai dhar poochhau jai ||
verses.translation: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevee bhaau kar mai pir dheh milai ||
verses.translation: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh upaae aape vekhai kis neRai kis dhoor ||
verses.translation: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin pir sa(n)ge jaaniaa pir raave sadhaa hadhoor ||1||
verses.translation: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His Constant Presence. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhe too chal gur kai bhai ||
verses.translation: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin raaveh pir aapanaa sahaje sach samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into the True One. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rateeaa sohaaganee sachai sabadh seegaar ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har var pain ghar aapanai gur kai het piaar ||
verses.translation: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sej suhaavee har ra(n)g ravai bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowing with the treasure of devotion.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so prabh preetam man vasai j sabhasai dhei adhaar ||2||
verses.translation: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pir saalaahan aapanaa tin kai hau sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arapee sir dheiee tin kai laagaa pai ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee ik pachhaaniaa dhoojaa bhaau chukai ||
verses.translation: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam pachhaaneeaai naanak sach samai ||3||29||62||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jee sachaa sach too sabh kichh terai cheerai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh tarasadhe fire bin gur bheTe peerai ||
verses.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without the Guru, they do not find You.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau bakhase bakhas le sookh sadhaa sareerai ||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sev karee sach gahir ga(n)bheerai ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere naam rate sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee naam salaaheeaai dhoojaa avar na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai no hukam hai beh sachaa dharam beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits and administers True Justice.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਓਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai dhusaT aatamaa oh teree sarakaar ||
verses.translation: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.

verses.original: ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: adhiaatamee har gun taas man japeh ek muraar ||
verses.translation: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee sevaa dharam rai karai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||2||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma serves them; blessed is the Lord who adorns them. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਤਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: man ke bikaar maneh tajai man chookai moh abhimaan ||
verses.translation: One who eliminates mental wickedness from within the mind, and casts out emotional attachment and egotistical pride,

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aatam raam pachhaaniaa sahaje naam samaan ||
verses.translation: comes to recognize the All-pervading Soul, and is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur mukat na paieeaai manmukh firai dhivaan ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the self-willed manmukhs do not find liberation; they wander around like lunatics.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh na cheenai kathanee badhanee kare bikhiaa maeh samaan ||3||
verses.translation: They do not contemplate the Shabad; engrossed in corruption, they utter only empty words. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap hai dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: He Himself is everything; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bolaae tiau boleeaai jaa aap bulaae soi ||
verses.translation: I speak just as He makes me speak, when He Himself makes me speak.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh baanee braham hai sabadh milaavaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Gurmukh is God Himself. Through the Shabad, we merge in Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal too jit seviaai sukh hoi ||4||30||63||
verses.translation: O Nanak, remember the Naam; serving Him, peace is obtained. ||4||30||63||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag haumai mail dhukh paiaa mal laagee dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: The world is polluted with the filth of egotism, suffering in pain. This filth sticks to them because of their love of duality.

verses.original: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mal haumai dhotee kivai na utarai je sau teerath nai ||
verses.translation: This filth of egotism cannot be washed away, even by taking cleansing baths at hundreds of sacred shrines.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh karam kamaavadhe dhoonee mal laagee aai ||
verses.translation: Performing all sorts of rituals, people are smeared with twice as much filth.

verses.original: ਪੜਿਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paRiaai mail na utarai poochhahu giaaneeaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: This filth is not removed by studying. Go ahead, and ask the wise ones. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gur saran aavai taa niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, coming to the Sanctuary of the Guru, you shall become immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh har har kar thake mail na sakee dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, but their filth cannot be removed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mailai bhagat na hoviee naam na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: With a polluted mind, devotional service cannot be performed, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be obtained.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh maile maile mue jaasan pat gavai ||
verses.translation: The filthy, self-willed manmukhs die in filth, and they depart in disgrace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man vasai mal haumai jai samai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and the filth of egotism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਲੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau a(n)dherai dheepak baaleeaai tiau gur giaan agiaan tajai ||2||
verses.translation: Like a lamp lit in the darkness, the spiritual wisdom of the Guru dispels ignorance. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹਗੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ham keeaa ham karahage ham moorakh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: "I have done this, and I will do that"-I am an idiotic fool for saying this!

verses.original: ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karanai vaalaa visariaa dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: I have forgotten the Doer of all; I am caught in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa jevadd dhukh nahee sabh bhav thake sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: There is no pain as great as the pain of Maya; it drives people to wander all around the world, until they become exhausted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sukh paieeaai sach naam ur dhaar ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace is found, with the True Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis no mele so milai hau tis balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meet and merge with the Lord.

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e man bhagatee ratiaa sach baanee nij thaau ||
verses.translation: This mind is attuned to devotional worship; through the True Word of Gurbani, it finds its own home.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਚੇ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man rate jihavaa ratee har gun sache gaau ||
verses.translation: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai sache maeh samaau ||4||31||64||
verses.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan birahu at agalaa kiau preetam milai ghar aai ||
verses.translation: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa dhekhaa prabh aapanaa prabh dhekhiaai dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jai puchhaa tin sajanaa prabh kit bidh milai milai ||1||
verses.translation: I go and ask my friends, ""How can I meet and merge with God?""||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere satiguraa mai tujh bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh mugadh saranaagatee kar kirapaa mele har soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite me with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa har naam kaa prabh aap milaavai soi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meet Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur har prabh bujhiaa gur jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau gur saranaiee ddeh pavaa kar dhiaa mele prabh soi ||2||
verses.translation: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united me with God. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh kinai na paiaa kar upaav thake sabh koi ||
verses.translation: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahas siaanap kar rahe man korai ra(n)g na hoi ||
verses.translation: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT kinai na paio jo beejai khaavai soi ||3||
verses.translation: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa teree aas prabh sabh jeea tere too(n) raas ||
verses.translation: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tudhahu khaalee ko nahee dhar gurmukhaa no saabaas ||
verses.translation: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਢਿ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: bikh bhaujal ddubadhe kadd lai jan naanak kee aradhaas ||4||1||65||
verses.translation: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam milai man tirapateeaai bin naamai dhirag jeevaas ||
verses.translation: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: koiee gurmukh sajan je milai mai dhase prabh gunataas ||
verses.translation: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hau tis viTahu chau kha(n)neeaai mai naam kare paragaas ||1||
verses.translation: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetamaa hau jeevaa naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai jeevan naa theeaai mere satigur naam dhiraRai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam amolak ratan hai poore satigur paas ||
verses.translation: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevai lagiaa kadd ratan dhevai paragaas ||
verses.translation: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੀਆ ਜੋ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n vaddabhaagee vadd bhaageeaa jo aai mile gur paas ||2||
verses.translation: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur purakh na bheTio se bhaagaheen vas kaal ||
verses.translation: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: oi fir fir jon bhavaie'eeh vich visaTaa kar vikaraal ||
verses.translation: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਦੁਆਸਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: onaa paas dhuaas na bhiTeeaai jin a(n)tar karodh cha(n)ddaal ||3||
verses.translation: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh a(n)mirat sar vaddabhaagee naaveh aai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.

verses.original: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aun janam janam kee mail utarai niramal naam dhiraRai ||
verses.translation: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak utam padh paiaa satigur kee liv lai ||4||2||66||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavaa gun vitharaa gun bolee meree mai ||
verses.translation: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sajan gunakaareeaa mil sajan har gun gai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: heerai heer mil bedhiaa ra(n)g chaloolai nai ||1||
verses.translation: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere govi(n)dhaa gun gaavaa tirapat man hoi ||
verses.translation: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar piaas har naam kee gur tus milaavai soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man ra(n)gahu vaddabhaageeho gur tuThaa kare pasaau ||
verses.translation: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur naam dhiraRaae ra(n)g siau hau satigur kai bal jaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin satigur har naam na labhiee lakh koTee karam kamaau ||2||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhaagaa satigur naa milai ghar baiThiaa nikaT nit paas ||
verses.translation: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agiaan dhukh bharam hai vich paRadhaa dhoor pieeaas ||
verses.translation: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਬੂਡਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe ka(n)chan naa theeaai manmukh loh booddaa beRee paas ||3||
verses.translation: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bohith har naav hai kit bidh chaRiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai vich bohith baiThaa aai ||
verses.translation: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n vaddabhaagee naanakaa jinaa satigur le milai ||4||3||67||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau pa(n)th dhasaiee nit khaRee koiee prabh dhase tin jaau ||
verses.translation: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee meraa piaaraa raaviaa tin peechhai laag firaau ||
verses.translation: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar mi(n)nat kar jodhaRee mai prabh milanai kaa chaau ||1||
verses.translation: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere bhaiee janaa koiee mo kau har prabh mel milai ||
verses.translation: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau satigur viTahu vaariaa jin har prabh dheeaa dhikhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: hoi nimaanee ddeh pavaa poore satigur paas ||
verses.translation: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: nimaaniaa gur maan hai gur satigur kare saabaas ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਊ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau gur saalaeh na rajuoo mai mele har prabh paas ||2||
verses.translation: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no sabh ko lochadhaa jetaa jagat sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhaagaa dharasan naa theeaai bhaagaheen beh roi ||
verses.translation: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is not obtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo har prabh bhaanaa so theeaa dhur likhiaa na meTai koi ||3||
verses.translation: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape satigur aap har aape mel milai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaa kar melasee gur satigur peechhai pai ||
verses.translation: In His Kindness, He unites us with Himself, as we follow the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: sabh jagajeevan jag aap hai naanak jal jaleh samai ||4||4||68||
verses.translation: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ras a(n)mrit naam ras at bhalaa kit bidh milai ras khai ||
verses.translation: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get to taste this essence?

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jai puchhahu sohaaganee tusaa kiau kar miliaa prabh aai ||
verses.translation: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, ""How did you come to meet God?""

verses.original: ਓਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਬੋਲਨੀ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: oi veparavaeh na bolanee hau mal mal dhovaa tin pai ||1||
verses.translation: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re mil sajan har gun saar ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your spiritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sajan satigur purakh hai dhukh kaddai haumai maar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdue your ego. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਦਇਆ ਪਈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukheeaa sohaaganee tin dhiaa piee man aai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਚਨੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vachan rata(n)n hai jo ma(n)ne su har ras khai ||
verses.translation: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee vadd jaane'eeh jin har ras khaadhaa gur bhai ||2||
verses.translation: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, are known as great and very fortunate. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih har ras van tin sabhat hai bhaagaheen nahee khai ||
verses.translation: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, but the unfortunate ones do not taste it.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur palai naa pavai manmukh rahe bilalai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry in misery.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi satigur aagai naa niveh onaa a(n)tar karodh balai ||3||
verses.translation: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har har ras aap hai aape har ras hoi ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is the Essence.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaa kar dhevasee gurmukh a(n)mrit choi ||
verses.translation: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa naanak har vasiaa man soi ||4||5||69||
verses.translation: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਚੜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas chaRai fir aathavai rain sabaiee jai ||
verses.translation: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.

verses.original: ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਨਰੁ ਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aav ghaTai nar naa bujhai nit moosaa laaj Tukai ||
verses.translation: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life.

verses.original: ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਗਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: guR miThaa maiaa pasariaa manmukh lag maakhee pachai pachai ||1||
verses.translation: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly, rotting away. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re mai meet sakhaa prabh soi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.

verses.original: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: put kalat moh bikh hai a(n)t belee koi na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to children and spouse is poison; in the end, no one will go along with you as your helper. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat har liv ubare alipat rahe saranai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, some embrace love for the Lord, and are saved. They remain detached and unaffected, and they find the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਓਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: onee chalan sadhaa nihaaliaa har kharach leeaa pat pai ||
verses.translation: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dharageh ma(n)ne'eeh har aap le gal lai ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa no pa(n)th paragaTaa dhar Thaak na koiee pai ||
verses.translation: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam salaahan naam man naam rahan liv lai ||
verses.translation: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remain attached to the Love of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anahadh dhunee dhar vajadhe dhar sachai sobhaa pai ||3||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they are honored at the True Door. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gurmukh naam salaahiaa tinaa sabh ko kahai saabaas ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee sa(n)gat dheh prabh mai jaachik kee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੩੧॥੬॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaag vadde tinaa gurmukhaa jin a(n)tar naam paragaas ||4||33||31||6||70||
verses.translation: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light of the Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa too rataa dhekh kai putr kalatr seegaar ||
verses.translation: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?

verses.original: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ras bhogeh khuseeaa kareh maaneh ra(n)g apaar ||
verses.translation: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸੀ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bahut kareh furamaisee varateh hoi afaar ||
verses.translation: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karataa chit na aaviee manmukh a(n)dh gavaar ||1||
verses.translation: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man sukhadhaataa har soi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paieeaai karam paraapat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਪੜਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: kapaR bhog lapaTaiaa suinaa rupaa khaak ||
verses.translation: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are only dust.

verses.original: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੇ ਕੀਏ ਰਥ ਅਥਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: haivar gaivar bahu ra(n)ge ke'ee rath athaak ||
verses.translation: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee chit na paavahee bisariaa sabh saak ||
verses.translation: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sirajanahaar bhulaiaa vin naavai naapaak ||2||
verses.translation: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੈਦਾ ਬਦ ਦੁਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕਤ ॥
verses.translit: laidhaa badh dhuaai too(n) maiaa kareh ikat ||
verses.translation: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਅਨਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too(n) pateeaaidhaa so san tujhai anit ||
verses.translation: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n)kaar kareh aha(n)kaareeaa viaapiaa man kee mat ||
verses.translation: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin prabh aap bhulaiaa naa tis jaat na pat ||3||
verses.translation: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਇਕੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh milaiaa iko sajan soi ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan kaa raakhaa ek hai kiaa maanas haumai roi ||
verses.translation: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo har jan bhaavai so kare dhar fer na paavai koi ||
verses.translation: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of his requests are denied.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rataa ra(n)g har sabh jag meh chaanan hoi ||4||1||71||
verses.translation: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe. ||4||1||71||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: man bilaas bahu ra(n)g ghanaa dhirasaT bhool khuseeaa ||
verses.translation: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.

verses.original: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਸੇ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhatradhaar baadhisaaheeaa vich sahase pareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re sukh saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa lekh tin purakh bidhaatai dhukh sahasaa miT giaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish and anxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਭਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jete thaan thana(n)taraa tete bhav aaiaa ||
verses.translation: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਵਡ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan paatee vadd bhoomeeaa meree meree kar pariaa ||2||
verses.translation: The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, ""This is mine! This is mine!""||2||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hukam chalaae nisa(n)g hoi varatai afariaa ||
verses.translation: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh ko vasagat kar lion bin naavai khaak raliaa ||3||
verses.translation: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced to dust. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: koT tetees sevakaa sidh saadhik dhar khariaa ||
verses.translation: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door the Siddhas and the Saadhus stand,

verses.original: ਗਿਰੰਬਾਰੀ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਬੀ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: gira(n)baaree vadd saahabee sabh naanak supan theeaa ||4||2||72||
verses.translation: who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਪੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhalake uTh papoleeaai vin bujhe mugadh ajaan ||
verses.translation: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and without understanding.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਛੁਟੈਗੀ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh chit na aaio chhuTaigee bebaan ||
verses.translation: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur setee chit lai sadhaa sadhaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
verses.translation: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: praanee too(n) aaiaa laahaa lain ||
verses.translation: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.

verses.original: ਲਗਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੁਫਕੜੇ ਸਭ ਮੁਕਦੀ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lagaa kit kufakaRe sabh mukadhee chalee rain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਦਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudham kare pas pa(n)kheeaa dhisai naahee kaal ||
verses.translation: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.

verses.original: ਓਤੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: otai saath manukh hai faathaa maiaa jaal ||
verses.translation: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਭਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mukate seiee bhaale'eeh j sachaa naam samaal ||2||
verses.translation: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਘਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo ghar chhadd gavaavanaa so lagaa man maeh ||
verses.translation: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it in your mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jai tudh varatanaa tis kee chi(n)taa naeh ||
verses.translation: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.

verses.original: ਫਾਥੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਿਕਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: faathe seiee nikale j gur kee pairee paeh ||3||
verses.translation: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee rakh na sakiee dhoojaa ko na dhikhai ||
verses.translation: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa bhaal kai aai piaa saranai ||
verses.translation: I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਇਆ ਕਢਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sachai paatisaeh ddubadhaa liaa kaddai ||4||3||73||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghaRee muhat kaa paahunaa kaaj savaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaam viaapiaa samajhai naahee gaavaar ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.

verses.original: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: auTh chaliaa pachhutaiaa pariaa vas ja(n)dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe too(n) baiThaa ka(n)dhee paeh ||
verses.translation: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je hovee poorab likhiaa taa gur kaa bachan kamaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਹ ਡਡੁਰੀ ਪਕੀ ਵਢਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: haree naahee neh ddadduree pakee vaddanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦਾਤ ਪਹੁਤਿਆ ਲਾਵੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਈਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lai lai dhaat pahutiaa laave kar tieeaar ||
verses.translation: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਦਾ ਤਾ ਲੁਣਿ ਮਿਣਿਆ ਖੇਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa hoaa hukam kirasaan dhaa taa lun miniaa khetaar ||2||
verses.translation: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa pahar dha(n)dhai giaa dhoojai bhar soiaa ||
verses.translation: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes in deep sleep.

verses.original: ਤੀਜੈ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਇਆ ਚਉਥੈ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teejai jhaakh jhakhaiaa chauthai bhor bhiaa ||
verses.translation: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.

verses.original: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kadh hee chit na aaio jin jeeau pi(n)dd dheeaa ||3||
verses.translation: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੀਆ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kau vaariaa jeeau keeaa kurabaan ||
verses.translation: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul to them.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis te sojhee man piee miliaa purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowing Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਡਿਠਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: naanak ddiThaa sadhaa naal har a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||4||4||74||
verses.translation: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||4||74||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe galaa visaran iko visar na jaau ||
verses.translation: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa sabh jalai kai gur naam dheeaa sach suaau ||
verses.translation: All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the true object of life.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਸਭੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਇਕਾ ਆਸ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa sabhe laeh kai ikaa aas kamaau ||
verses.translation: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jinee satigur seviaa tin agai miliaa thaau ||1||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere karate no saalaeh ||
verses.translation: O my mind, praise the Creator.

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਛਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe chhadd siaanapaa gur kee pairee paeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bhukh neh viaapiee je sukhadhaataa man hoi ||
verses.translation: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.

verses.original: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਛਿਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kit hee ka(n)m na chhijeeaai jaa hiradhai sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਥ ਦੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) rakheh hath dhe tis maar na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: No one can kill that one unto whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa gur seveeaai sabh avagan kaddai dhoi ||2||
verses.translation: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa ma(n)gai sevako laieeaa(n) apunee sev ||
verses.translation: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਸਕਤੇ ਤੂਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g masakate tooThai paavaa dhev ||
verses.translation: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh vasagat saahibai aape karan karev ||
verses.translation: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇਵ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur kai balihaaranai manasaa sabh poorev ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਜਣੋ ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: eiko dhisai sajano iko bhaiee meet ||
verses.translation: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikasai dhee saamagaree ikasai dhee hai reet ||
verses.translation: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.

verses.original: ਇਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikas siau man maaniaa taa hoaa nihachal cheet ||
verses.translation: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousness becomes steady and stable.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਤੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੫॥
verses.translit: sach khaanaa sach painanaa Tek naanak sach keet ||4||5||75||
verses.translation: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one's Support, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe thok paraapate je aavai ik hath ||
verses.translation: All things are received if the One is obtained.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath safal hai je sachaa sabadh kath ||
verses.translation: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਥਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur te mahal paraapate jis likhiaa hovai math ||1||
verses.translation: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man ekas siau chit lai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭ ਧੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ekas bin sabh dha(n)dh hai sabh mithiaa moh mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya is totally false. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: lakh khuseeaa paatisaaheeaa je satigur nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh ek har naam dhei meraa man tan seetal hoi ||
verses.translation: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur charan gahe ||2||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: safal moorat safalaa ghaRee jit sache naal piaar ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh sa(n)taap na lagiee jis har kaa naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baeh pakaR gur kaaddiaa soiee utariaa paar ||3||
verses.translation: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||

verses.original: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: thaan suhaavaa pavit hai jithai sa(n)t sabhaa ||
verses.translation: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.

verses.original: ਢੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: ddoiee tis hee no milai jin pooraa guroo labhaa ||
verses.translation: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਧਾ ਘਰੁ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੬॥
verses.translit: naanak badhaa ghar tahaa(n) jithai mrit na janam jaraa ||4||6||76||
verses.translation: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no old age. ||4||6||76||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: soiee dhiaaieeaai jeeaRe sir saahaa(n) paatisaahu ||
verses.translation: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮਨ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis hee kee kar aas man jis kaa sabhas vesaahu ||
verses.translation: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh siaanapaa chhadd kai gur kee charanee paahu ||1||
verses.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man mere sukh sahaj setee jap naau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਇੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh dhiaai too(n) gun goi(n)dh nit gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee saranee par manaa jis jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis simarat sukh hoi ghanaa dhukh dharadh na moole hoi ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa kar chaakaree prabh saahib sachaa soi ||2||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat hoi niramalaa kaTeeaai jam kee faas ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, and the noose of death shall be cut away.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa bhai bha(n)jano tis aagai kar aradhaas ||
verses.translation: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mihar kare jis miharavaan taa(n) kaaraj aavai raas ||3||
verses.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahuto bahut vakhaaneeaai uoocho uoochaa thaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of the High.

verses.original: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa keemat keh na sakaau ||
verses.translation: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੭॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh miaa kar sach dhevahu apunaa naau ||4||7||77||
verses.translation: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sreeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaae so sukhee tis mukh uoojal hoi ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te paieeaai paragaT sabhanee loi ||
verses.translation: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat kai ghar vasai eko sachaa soi ||1||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har har naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਗੈ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam sahaiee sadhaa sa(n)g aagai le chhaddai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਵਨੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa keeaa vaddiaaieeaa kavanai aaveh kaam ||
verses.translation: What good is worldly greatness?

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaa ra(n)g sabh fikaa jaato binas nidhaan ||
verses.translation: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kai hiradhai har vasai so pooraa paradhaan ||2||
verses.translation: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo kee hoh renukaa apanaa aap tiaag ||
verses.translation: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aupaav siaanap sagal chhadd gur kee charanee laag ||
verses.translation: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat ratan hoi jis masatak hovai bhaag ||3||
verses.translation: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: tisai paraapat bhaieeho jis dhevai prabh aap ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis binasai haumai taap ||
verses.translation: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੮॥
verses.translit: naanak kau gur bheTiaa binase sagal sa(n)taap ||4||8||78||
verses.translation: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਕੋ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik pachhaanoo jeea kaa iko rakhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.

verses.original: ਇਕਸ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਰਾ ਇਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikas kaa man aasaraa iko praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis saranaiee sadhaa sukh paarabraham karataar ||1||
verses.translation: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere sagal upaav tiaag ||
verses.translation: O my mind, give up all these efforts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਤ ਇਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa aaraadh nit ikas kee liv laag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eiko bhaiee mit ik iko maat pitaa ||
verses.translation: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.

verses.original: ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eikas kee man Tek hai jin jeeau pi(n)dd dhitaa ||
