verses.translation: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so prabh manahu na visarai jin sabh kichh vas keetaa ||2||
verses.translation: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghar iko baahar iko thaan thana(n)tar aap ||
verses.translation: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself is in all places and interspaces.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh jin ke'ee aaTh pahar tis jaap ||
verses.translation: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eikas setee ratiaa na hovee sog sa(n)taap ||3||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh ek hai dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa jo tis bhaavai su hoi ||
verses.translation: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੭੯॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pooraa bhiaa jap naanak sachaa soi ||4||9||79||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur siau chit laiaa se poore paradhaan ||
verses.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and famous.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau aap dhiaal hoi tin upajai man giaan ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those unto whom the Lord Himself shows Mercy.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin kau masatak likhiaa tin paiaa har naam ||1||
verses.translation: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere eko naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa sukh uoopajeh dharageh paidhaa jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaa bhau giaa bhaau bhagat gopaal ||
verses.translation: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service to the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat niramalaa aap kare pratipaal ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure; the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam maran kee mal kaTeeaai gur dharasan dhekh nihaal ||2||
verses.translation: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa paarabraham prabh soi ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa dhaataa ek hai dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis saranaiee chhuTeeaai keetaa loRe su hoi ||3||
verses.translation: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jin man vasiaa paarabraham se poore paradhaan ||
verses.translation: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord God abides.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee sobhaa niramalee paragaT bhiee jahaan ||
verses.translation: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੮੦॥
verses.translit: jinee meraa prabh dhiaaiaa naanak tin kurabaan ||4||10||80||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mil satigur sabh dhukh giaa har sukh vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, all my sufferings have ended, and the Peace of the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot pragaaseeaa ekas siau liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light illuminates my inner being, and I am lovingly absorbed in the One.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo mukh uoojalaa poorab likhiaa pai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy Saint, my face is radiant; I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਣੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun govi(n)dh nit gaavane niramal saachai nai ||1||
verses.translation: I constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. Through the True Name, I have become spotlessly pure. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur sabadhee sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, you shall find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee chaakaree birathaa jai na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Working for the Perfect Guru, no one goes away empty-handed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: man keeaa ichhaa(n) pooreeaa paiaa naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee sadhaa sa(n)g karanaihaar pachhaan ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is always with you; recognize Him as the Creator.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee mukh uoojalaa jap naam dhaan isanaan ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, your face shall be radiant. Chanting the Naam, you shall receive the benefits of giving charity and taking cleansing baths.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਤਜਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh binasiaa tajiaa sabh abhimaan ||2||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and greed are eliminated, and all egotistical pride is abandoned. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa laahaa laabh naam pooran hoe kaam ||
verses.translation: The Profit of the Naam is obtained, and all affairs are brought to fruition.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh meliaa dheeaa apanaa naam ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God unites us with Himself, and He blesses us with the Naam.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa reh giaa aap hoaa miharavaan ||
verses.translation: My comings and goings in reincarnation have come to an end; He Himself has bestowed His Mercy.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sach mahal ghar paiaa gur kaa sabadh pachhaan ||3||
verses.translation: I have obtained my home in the True Mansion of His Presence, realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau raakhadhaa aapanee kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: His humble devotees are protected and saved; He Himself showers His Blessings upon us.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat mukh uoojale saache ke gun saar ||
verses.translation: In this world and in the world hereafter, radiant are the faces of those who cherish and enshrine the Glories of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਦੇ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun saaradhe rate ra(n)g apaar ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they lovingly dwell upon His Glories; they are imbued with His Infinite Love.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham sukh saagaro naanak sadh balihaar ||4||11||81||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God, the Ocean of Peace. ||4||11||81||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur je milai paieeaai sabadh nidhaan ||
verses.translation: If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the Treasure of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee japeeaai a(n)mirat naam ||
verses.translation: Please grant Your Grace, God, that we may meditate on Your Ambrosial Naam.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaaTeeaai laagai sahaj dhiaan ||1||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death are taken away; we are intuitively centered on His Meditation. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man prabh saranaiee pai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, seek the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bin dhoojaa ko nahee eko naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, there is no other at all. Meditate on the One and only Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kahan na jaieeaai saagar gunee athaahu ||
verses.translation: His Value cannot be estimated; He is the Vast Ocean of Excellence.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee mil sa(n)gatee sachaa sabadh visaahu ||
verses.translation: O most fortunate ones, join the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation; purchase the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar sevaa sukh saagarai sir saahaa paatisaahu ||2||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal kaa aasaraa dhoojaa naahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: I take the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet; there is no other place of rest for me.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhar teree paarabraham terai taan rahaau ||
verses.translation: I lean upon You as my Support, O Supreme Lord God. I exist only by Your Power.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nimaaniaa prabh maan too(n) terai sa(n)g samaau ||3||
verses.translation: O God, You are the Honor of the dishonored. I seek to merge with You. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: har japeeaai aaraadheeaai aaTh pahar govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Chant the Lord's Name and contemplate the Lord of the World, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan tan dhan rakhe kar kirapaa raakhee ji(n)dh ||
verses.translation: He preserves our soul, our breath of life, body and wealth. By His Grace, He protects our soul.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੋਖ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੮੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sagale dhokh utaarian prabh paarabraham bakhasi(n)dh ||4||12||82||
verses.translation: O Nanak, all pain has been washed away, by the Supreme Lord God, the Forgiver. ||4||12||82||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: preet lagee tis sach siau marai na aavai jai ||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with the True Lord. He does not die, He does not come and go.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa vechhoRiaa vichhuRai sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: In separation, He is not separated from us; He is pervading and permeating amongst all.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dharadh dhukh bha(n)janaa sevak kai sat bhai ||
verses.translation: He is the Destroyer of the pain and suffering of the meek. He bears True Love for His servants.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: acharaj roop nira(n)jano gur melaiaa mai ||1||
verses.translation: Wondrous is the Form of the Immaculate One. Through the Guru, I have met Him, O my mother! ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re meet karahu prabh soi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, make God your Friend.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh pareet dhirag sukhee na dheesai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Cursed is emotional attachment and love of Maya; no one is seen to be at peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਾਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੀਲਵੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaanaa dhaataa seelava(n)t niramal roop apaar ||
verses.translation: God is Wise, Giving, Tender-hearted, Pure, Beautiful and Infinite.

verses.original: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sakhaa sahaiee at vaddaa uoochaa vaddaa apaar ||
verses.translation: He is our Companion and Helper, Supremely Great, Lofty and Utterly Infinite.

verses.original: ਬਾਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baalak biradh na jaaneeaai nihachal tis dharavaar ||
verses.translation: He is not known as young or old; His Court is Steady and Stable.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo ma(n)geeaai soiee paieeaai nidhaaraa aadhaar ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever we seek from Him, we receive. He is the Support of the unsupported. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis pekhat kilavikh hireh man tan hovai saa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Seeing Him, our evil inclinations vanish; mind and body become peaceful and tranquil.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik man ek dhiaaieeaai man kee laeh bharaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: With one-pointed mind, meditate on the One Lord, and the doubts of your mind will be dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan navatan sadhaa pooran jaa kee dhaat ||
verses.translation: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Ever-fresh Being. His Gift is Perfect and Complete.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa aaraadheeaai dhin visarahu nahee raat ||3||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him. Day and night, do not forget Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਖਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin kaa sakhaa govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Lord of the Universe as his Companion.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੋ ਸਗਲ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਇਹ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan arapee sabho sagal vaareeaai ieh ji(n)dh ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all to Him. I totally sacrifice my soul to Him.

verses.original: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਸਦ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhai sunai hadhoor sadh ghaT ghaT braham ravi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Seeing and hearing, He is always close at hand. In each and every heart, God is pervading.

verses.original: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਨੋ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: akirataghanaa no paaladhaa prabh naanak sadh bakhasi(n)dh ||4||13||83||
verses.translation: Even the ungrateful ones are cherished by God. O Nanak, He is forever the Forgiver. ||4||13||83||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan dhan jin prabh dheeaa rakhiaa sahaj savaar ||
verses.translation: This mind, body and wealth were given by God, who naturally adorns us.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa kar thaapiaa a(n)tar jot apaar ||
verses.translation: He has blessed us with all our energy, and infused His Infinite Light deep within us.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa prabh simareeaai a(n)tar rakh ur dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God; keep Him enshrined in your heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, without the Lord, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh saranaiee sadhaa rahu dhookh na viaapai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remain in God's Sanctuary forever, and no suffering shall afflict you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: ratan padhaarath maanakaa suinaa rupaa khaak ||
verses.translation: Jewels, treasures, pearls, gold and silver-all these are just dust.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਭੇ ਸਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhapaa kooRe sabhe saak ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, children and relatives-all relations are false.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਸੁ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin keetaa tiseh na jaaniee manmukh pas naapaak ||2||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is an insulting beast; he does not acknowledge the One who created him. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa tis no jaanai dhoor ||
verses.translation: The Lord is pervading within and beyond, and yet people think that He is far away.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa laagee rach rahiaa a(n)tar haumai koor ||
verses.translation: They are engrossed in clinging desires; within their hearts there is ego and falsehood.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਆਵਹਿ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhagatee naam vihooniaa aaveh va(n)n(j)h poor ||3||
verses.translation: Without devotion to the Naam, crowds of people come and go. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raakh leh prabh karanahaar jeea ja(n)t kar dhiaa ||
verses.translation: Please preserve Your beings and creatures, God; O Creator Lord, please be merciful!

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਜਮ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin prabh koi na rakhanahaar mahaa bikaT jam bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Without God, there is no saving grace. The Messenger of Death is cruel and unfeeling.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarau kar apunee har miaa ||4||14||84||
verses.translation: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord! ||4||14||84||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਮੈ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: meraa tan ar dhan meraa raaj roop mai dhes ||
verses.translation: "My body and my wealth; my ruling power, my beautiful form and country-mine!"

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: sut dhaaraa banitaa anek bahut ra(n)g ar ves ||
verses.translation: You may have children, a wife and many mistresses; you may enjoy all sorts of pleasures and fine clothes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam ridhai na vasiee kaaraj kitai na lekh ||1||
verses.translation: And yet, if the Name of the Lord does not abide within the heart, none of it has any use or value. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har har naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar sa(n)gat nit saadh kee gur charanee chit lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Always keep the Company of the Holy, and focus your consciousness on the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan dhiaaieeaai masatak hovai bhaag ||
verses.translation: Those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads meditate on the Treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sabh savaare'eh gur kee charanee laag ||
verses.translation: All their affairs are brought to fruition, holding onto the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haumai rog bhram kaTeeaai naa aavai naa jaag ||2||
verses.translation: The diseases of ego and doubt are cast out; they shall not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar sa(n)gat too saadh kee aThasaTh teerath naau ||
verses.translation: Let the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, be your cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan man tan hare saachaa eh suaau ||
verses.translation: Your soul, breath of life, mind and body shall blossom forth in lush profusion; this is the true purpose of life.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaithai mileh vaddaieeaa dharageh paaveh thaau ||3||
verses.translation: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: kare karaae aap prabh sabh kichh tis hee haath ||
verses.translation: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: maar aape jeevaaladhaa a(n)tar baahar saath ||
verses.translation: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੫॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee sarab ghaTaa ke naath ||4||15||85||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: saran pe prabh aapane gur hoaa kirapaal ||
verses.translation: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਐ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: satagur kai upadhesiaai binase sarab ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar lagaa raam naam a(n)mirat nadhar nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His Ambrosial Glance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere satigur sevaa saar ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kare dhiaa prabh aapanee ik nimakh na manahu visaar || rahaau ||
verses.translation: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਟਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gun govi(n)dh nit gaave'eeh avagun kaTanahaar ||
verses.translation: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of demerits.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bin har naam na sukh hoi kar ddiThe bisathaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatious displays, I have come to see this.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaje sifatee ratiaa bhavajal utare paar ||2||
verses.translation: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: teerath varat lakh sa(n)jamaa paieeaai saadhoo dhoor ||
verses.translation: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austere self-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: look kamaavai kis te jaa vekhai sadhaa hadhoor ||
verses.translation: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa prabh meraa bharapoor ||3||
verses.translation: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach paatisaahee amar sach sache sachaa thaan ||
verses.translation: True is His Empire, and True is His Command. True is His Seat of True Authority.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਓਨੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachee kudharat dhaareean sach sirajion jahaan ||
verses.translation: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੬॥
verses.translit: naanak japeeaai sach naam hau sadhaa sadhaa kurabaan ||4||16||86||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||16||86||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: audham kar har jaapanaa vaddabhaagee dhan khaaT ||
verses.translation: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g har simaranaa mal janam janam kee kaaT ||1||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere raam naam jap jaap ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man ichhe fal bhu(n)ch too sabh chookai sog sa(n)taap || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaaran tan dhaariaa so prabh ddiThaa naal ||
verses.translation: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal pooriaa prabh aapanee nadhar nihaal ||2||
verses.translation: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal hoiaa laagee saach pareet ||
verses.translation: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਭਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan bhaje paarabraham ke sabh jap tap tin hee keet ||3||
verses.translation: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed all meditations and austerities. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ratan javehar maanikaa a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੭॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ras jan naanak har gun gaau ||4||17||87||
verses.translation: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing the Glories of God. ||4||17||87||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਸਤੁ ਸਉਣੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soiee saasat saun soi jit japeeaai har naau ||
verses.translation: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes to chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal gur dhan dheeaa miliaa nithaave thaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, without shelter, have now obtained Shelter.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachee poo(n)jee sach sa(n)jamo aaTh pahar gun gaau ||
verses.translation: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh bheTiaa maran na aavan jaau ||1||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go in reincarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har bhaj sadhaa ik ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar rav rahiaa sadhaa sahaiee sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as your Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukhaa kee mit kiaa ganee jaa simaree govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin chaakhiaa se tirapataasiaa uh ras jaanai ji(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat man vasai prabh preetam bakhasi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, God, the Beloved, the Forgiver, comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਜ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa prabh aapanaa soiee raaj nari(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: One who has served his God is the emperor of kings||2||

verses.original: ਅਉਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aausar har jas gun raman jit koT majan isanaan ||
verses.translation: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings the merit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣਵਤੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ucharai gunavatee koi na pujai dhaan ||
verses.translation: The tongue which chants these Praises is worthy; there is no charity equal to this.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaar man tan vasai dhiaal purakh miharavaan ||
verses.translation: Blessing us with His Glance of Grace, the Kind and Compassionate, All-powerful Lord comes to dwell within the mind and body.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan tis dhaa hau sadhaa sadhaa kurabaan ||3||
verses.translation: My soul, body and wealth are His. Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: miliaa kadhe na vichhuRai jo meliaa karataar ||
verses.translation: One whom the Creator Lord has met and joined to Himself shall never again be separated.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasaa ke ba(n)dhan kaTiaa saachai sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord breaks the bonds of His slave.

verses.original: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolaa maarag paion gun avagun na beechaar ||
verses.translation: The doubter has been put back on the path; his merits and demerits have not been considered.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੮॥
verses.translit: naanak tis saranaagatee j sagal ghaTaa aadhaar ||4||18||88||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the One who is the Support of every heart. ||4||18||88||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa sachaa simareeaai man tan niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, repeat the True Name, and your mind and body shall become pure.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਕ ਅਗਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa saak agale tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Your mother and father and all your relations-without Him, there are none at all.

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mihar kare je aapanee chasaa na visarai soi ||1||
verses.translation: If God Himself bestows His Mercy, then He is not forgotten, even for an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere saachaa sev jichar saas ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the True One, as long as you have the breath of life.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin sache sabh kooR hai a(n)te hoi binaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True One, everything is false; in the end, all shall perish. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saahib meraa niramalaa tis bin rahan na jai ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is Immaculate and Pure; without Him, I cannot even survive.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: merai man tan bhukh at agalee koiee aan milaavai mai ||
verses.translation: Within my mind and body, there is such a great hunger; if only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother!

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਸਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa bhaaleeaa seh bin avar na jai ||2||
verses.translation: I have searched the four corners of the world-without our Husband Lord, there is no other place of rest. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis aagai aradhaas kar jo mele karataar ||
verses.translation: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa naam kaa pooraa jis bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the Naam; His Treasure is perfect and overflowing.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa saalaaheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||3||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, praise the One, who has no end or limitation. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਚਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: paravadhagaar saalaaheeaai jis dhe chalat anek ||
verses.translation: Praise God, the Nurturer and Cherisher; His Wondrous Ways are unlimited.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਏਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa aaraadheeaai ehaa mat visekh ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him; this is the most wonderful wisdom.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: man tan miThaa tis lagai jis masatak naanak lekh ||4||19||89||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God's Flavor is sweet to the minds and bodies of those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads. ||4||19||89||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janahu mil bhaieeho sachaa naam samaal ||
verses.translation: Meet with the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, and contemplate the True Name.

verses.original: ਤੋਸਾ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tosaa ba(n)dhahu jeea kaa aaithai othai naal ||
verses.translation: For the journey of the soul, gather those supplies which will go with you here and hereafter.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paieeaai apanee nadhar nihaal ||
verses.translation: These are obtained from the Perfect Guru, when God bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karam paraapat tis hovai jis no hoi dhiaal ||1||
verses.translation: Those unto whom He is Merciful, receive His Grace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, there is no other as great as the Guru.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa thaau na ko sujhai gur mele sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot imagine any other place. The Guru leads me to meet the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal padhaarath tis mile jin gur ddiThaa jai ||
verses.translation: Those who go to see the Guru obtain all treasures.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur charanee jin man lagaa se vaddabhaagee mai ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet are very fortunate, O my mother.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhaataa samarath gur gur sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru is All-powerful. The Guru is All-pervading, contained amongst all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਏ ਤਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur paramesar paarabraham gur ddubadhaa le tarai ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God. The Guru lifts up and saves those who are drowning. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: kit mukh gur saalaaheeaai karan kaaran samarath ||
verses.translation: How shall I praise the Guru, the All-powerful Cause of causes?

verses.original: ਸੇ ਮਥੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਹਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: se mathe nihachal rahe jin gur dhaariaa hath ||
verses.translation: Those, upon whose foreheads the Guru has placed His Hand, remain steady and stable.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆਲਿਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਪਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)mirat naam peeaaliaa janam maran kaa path ||
verses.translation: The Guru has led me to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has released me from the cycle of birth and death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਲਥੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur paramesar seviaa bhai bha(n)jan dhukh lath ||3||
verses.translation: I serve the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, the Dispeller of fear; my suffering has been taken away. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਘਖੰਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur gahir gabheer hai sukh saagar aghakha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Deep and Profound Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of sin.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਡੰਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur seviaa aapanaa jamadhoot na laagai dda(n)dd ||
verses.translation: For those who serve their Guru, there is no punishment at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur naal tul na lagiee khoj ddiThaa brahama(n)dd ||
verses.translation: There is none to compare with the Guru; I have searched and looked throughout the entire universe.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਡੁ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੯੦॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan satigur dheeaa sukh naanak man meh ma(n)dd ||4||20||90||
verses.translation: The True Guru has bestowed the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, the mind is filled with peace. ||4||20||90||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਕਉੜਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa kar kai khaiaa kauRaa upajiaa saadh ||
verses.translation: People eat what they believe to be sweet, but it turns out to be bitter in taste.

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਦ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee meet suridh ke'ee bikhiaa rachiaa baadh ||
verses.translation: They attach their affections to brothers and friends, uselessly engrossed in corruption.

verses.original: ਜਾਂਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa(n)dhe bilam na hoviee vin naavai bisamaadh ||1||
verses.translation: They vanish without a moment's delay; without God's Name, they are stunned and amazed. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man satagur kee sevaa laag ||
verses.translation: O my mind, attach yourself to the service of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so vinasanaa man kee mat tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen, shall pass away. Abandon the intellectualizations of your mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ਧਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau kookar harakaiaa dhaavai dheh dhis jai ||
verses.translation: Like the mad dog running around in all directions,

verses.original: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ ਸਭ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lobhee ja(n)t na jaaniee bhakh abhakh sabh khai ||
verses.translation: the greedy person, unaware, consumes everything, edible and non-edible alike.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh madh biaapiaa fir fir jonee pai ||2||
verses.translation: Engrossed in the intoxication of sexual desire and anger, people wander through reincarnation over and over again. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa jaal pasaariaa bheetar chog banai ||
verses.translation: Maya has spread out her net, and in it, she has placed the bait.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪੰਖੀ ਫਾਸਿਆ ਨਿਕਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa pa(n)khee faasiaa nikas na paae mai ||
verses.translation: The bird of desire is caught, and cannot find any escape, O my mother.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin keetaa tiseh na jaaniee fir fir aavai jai ||3||
verses.translation: One who does not know the Lord who created him, comes and goes in reincarnation over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: anik prakaaree mohiaa bahu bidh ih sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: By various devices, and in so many ways, this world is enticed.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ਸੋ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no rakhai so rahai sa(n)mrith purakh apaar ||
verses.translation: They alone are saved, whom the All-powerful, Infinite Lord protects.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: har jan har liv udhare naanak sadh balihaar ||4||21||91||
verses.translation: The servants of the Lord are saved by the Love of the Lord. O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||21||91||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡੰਫੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: goil aaiaa goilee kiaa tis dda(n)f pasaar ||
verses.translation: The herdsman comes to the pasture lands-what good are his ostentatious displays here?

verses.original: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: muhalat pu(n)nee chalanaa too(n) sa(n)mal ghar baar ||1||
verses.translation: When your allotted time is up, you must go. Take care of your real hearth and home. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaau manaa satigur sev piaar ||
verses.translation: O mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and serve the True Guru with love.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਥੋੜੜੀ ਬਾਤ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa thoRaRee baat gumaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why do you take pride in trivial matters? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਸਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaise rain paraahune uTh chalaseh parabhaat ||
verses.translation: Like an overnight guest, you shall arise and depart in the morning.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਰਤਾ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਫੁਲਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kiaa too(n) rataa girasat siau sabh fulaa kee baagaat ||2||
verses.translation: Why are you so attached to your household? It is all like flowers in the garden. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kiaa kareh jin dheeaa so prabh loR ||
verses.translation: Why do you say, ""Mine, mine""? Look to God, who has given it to you.

verses.original: ਸਰਪਰ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarapar uThee chalanaa chhadd jaasee lakh karoR ||3||
verses.translation: It is certain that you must arise and depart, and leave behind your hundreds of thousands and millions. ||3||

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿਆ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਓਇ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh bhramatiaa dhulabh janam paioi ||
verses.translation: Through 8.4 million incarnations you have wandered, to obtain this rare and precious human life.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਓਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal too(n) so dhin neRaa aaioi ||4||22||92||
verses.translation: O Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the day of departure is drawing near! ||4||22||92||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tichar vaseh suhelaRee jichar saathee naal ||
verses.translation: As long as the soul-companion is with the body, it dwells in happiness.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa saathee uThee chaliaa taa dhan khaakoo raal ||1||
verses.translation: But when the companion arises and departs, then the body-bride mingles with dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man bairaag bhiaa dharasan dhekhanai kaa chaau ||
verses.translation: My mind has become detached from the world; it longs to see the Vision of God's Darshan.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su teraa thaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Blessed is Your Place. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jichar vasiaa ka(n)t ghar jeeau jeeau sabh kahaat ||
verses.translation: As long as the soul-husband dwells in the body-house, everyone greets you with respect.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੰਤੜਾ ਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa uThee chalasee ka(n)taRaa taa koi na puchhai teree baat ||2||
verses.translation: But when the soul-husband arises and departs, then no one cares for you at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaRai sahu sev too(n) saahuraRai sukh vas ||
verses.translation: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, in your in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur mil chaj achaar sikh tudh kadhe na lagai dhukh ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, be a sincere student of proper conduct, and suffering shall never touch you. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵੰਞਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੁਕਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa saahurai va(n)n(j)naa sabh mukalaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: Everyone shall go to their Husband Lord. Everyone shall be given their ceremonial send-off after their marriage.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dha(n)n sohaaganee jin seh naal piaar ||4||23||93||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed are the happy soul-brides, who are in love with their Husband Lord. ||4||23||93||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House:

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕੁ ਓਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran ek ohee jin keeaa aakaar ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes, who has created the creation.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiseh dhiaavahu man mere sarab ko aadhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate on the One, O my mind, who is the Support of all. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan man meh dhiaai ||
verses.translation: Meditate within your mind on the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd sagal siaanapaa saach sabadh liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Give up all your clever mental tricks, and lovingly attune yourself to the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh kales na bhau biaapai gur ma(n)tr hiradhai hoi ||
verses.translation: Suffering, agony and fear do not cling to one whose heart is filled with the GurMantra.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koT jatanaa kar rahe gur bin tario na koi ||2||
verses.translation: Trying millions of things, people have grown weary, but without the Guru, none have been saved. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh dharasan man saadhaarai paap sagale jaeh ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, the mind is comforted and all sins depart.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hau tin kai balihaaranai j gur kee pairee paeh ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat man vasai saach har kaa naau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the True Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੪॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee naanakaa jinaa man ih bhaau ||4||24||94||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are those, O Nanak, whose minds are filled with this love. ||4||24||94||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)ch har dhan pooj satigur chhodd sagal vikaar ||
verses.translation: Gather in the Wealth of the Lord, worship the True Guru, and give up all your corrupt ways.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin too(n) saaj savaariaa har simar hoi udhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord who created and adorned you, and you shall be saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap man naam ek apaar ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the One, the Unique and Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਿਦੇ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: praan man tan jineh dheeaa ridhe kaa aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He gave you the praanaa, the breath of life, and your mind and body. He is the Support of the heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar maate viaapiaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The world is drunk, engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਪਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pau sa(n)t saranee laag charanee miTai dhookh a(n)dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and fall at their feet; your suffering and darkness shall be removed. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa kamaavai eh karanee saar ||
verses.translation: Practice truth, contentment and kindness; this is the most excellent way of life.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd sabh hoi renaa jis dhei prabh nira(n)kaar ||3||
verses.translation: One who is so blessed by the Formless Lord God renounces selfishness, and becomes the dust of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so sagal too(n)hai pasariaa paasaar ||
verses.translation: All that is seen is You, Lord, the expansion of the expanse.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur bharam kaaTiaa sagal braham beechaar ||4||25||95||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has removed my doubts; I recognize God in all. ||4||25||95||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukirat sukirat ma(n)dhe sa(n)saar sagalaanaa ||
verses.translation: The whole world is engrossed in bad deeds and good deeds.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuhahoo(n) te rahat bhagat hai koiee viralaa jaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: God's devotee is above both, but those who understand this are very rare. ||1||

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur sarabe samaanaa ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is all-pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਣਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa kahau sunau suaamee too(n) vadd purakh sujaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What should I say, and what should I hear? O my Lord and Master, You are Great, All-powerful and All-knowing. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maan abhimaan ma(n)dhe so sevak naahee ||
verses.translation: One who is influenced by praise and blame is not God's servant.

verses.original: ਤਤ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੰਧਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tat samadharasee sa(n)tahu koiee koT ma(n)dhaahee ||2||
verses.translation: One who sees the essence of reality with impartial vision, O Saints, is very rare-one among millions. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahan kahaavan ih keerat karalaa ||
verses.translation: People talk on and on about Him; they consider this to be praise of God.

verses.original: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kathan kahan te mukataa gurmukh koiee viralaa ||3||
verses.translation: But rare indeed is the Gurmukh, who is above this mere talk. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gat avigat kachh nadhar na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is not concerned with deliverance or bondage.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੬॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kee ren naanak dhaan paiaa ||4||26||96||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||26||96||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: terai bharosai piaare mai laadd laddaiaa ||
verses.translation: Relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have cherished and loved you.

verses.original: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhooleh chookeh baarik too(n) har pitaa maiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: suhelaa kahan kahaavan ||
verses.translation: It is easy to speak and talk,

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa bikham bhaavan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: but it is difficult to accept Your Will. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਆਪਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau maan taan karau teraa hau jaanau aapaa ||
verses.translation: I stand tall; You are my Strength. I know that You are mine.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਧਿ ਸਭਹਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਬਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh hee madh sabheh te baahar bemuhataaj baapaa ||2||
verses.translation: Inside of all, and outside of all, You are our Self-sufficient Father. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa hau jaanau naahee teree kavan jugataa ||
verses.translation: O Father, I do not know-how can I know Your Way?

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan mukat sa(n)tahu meree raakhai mamataa ||3||
verses.translation: He frees us from bondage, O Saints, and saves us from possessiveness. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal Thaakur rahio aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: Becoming Merciful, my Lord and Master has ended my comings and goings in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੭॥
verses.translit: gur mil naanak paarabraham pachhaanaa ||4||27||97||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God. ||4||27||97||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਕਟਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil bhaieeaa kaTiaRaa jamakaal ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਹੋਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib man vuThaa hoaa khasam dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind; my Lord and Master has become Merciful.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur bheTiaa binasiaa sabh ja(n)jaal ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, all my worldly entanglements have ended. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere satiguraa hau tudh viTahu kurabaan ||
verses.translation: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere dharasan kau balihaaranai tus dhitaa a(n)mirat naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. By the Pleasure of Your Will, You have blessed me with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jin too(n) seviaa bhaau kar seiee purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: Those who have served You with love are truly wise.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tinaa pichhai chhuTeeaai jin a(n)dhar naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Those who have the Treasure of the Naam within emancipate others as well as themselves.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਆਤਮ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur jevadd dhaataa ko nahee jin dhitaa aatam dhaan ||2||
verses.translation: There is no other Giver as great as the Guru, who has given the gift of the soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aae se paravaan heh jin gur miliaa subhai ||
verses.translation: Blessed and acclaimed is the coming of those who have met the Guru with loving faith.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sache setee ratiaa dharageh baisan jai ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karate hath vaddiaaieeaa poorab likhiaa pai ||3||
verses.translation: Greatness is in the Hands of the Creator; it is obtained by pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: sach karataa sach karanahaar sach saahib sach Tek ||
verses.translation: True is the Creator, True is the Doer. True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Support.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੋ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: sacho sach vakhaaneeaai sacho budh bibek ||
verses.translation: So speak the Truest of the True. Through the True One, an intuitive and discerning mind is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੮॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa jap naanak jeevai ek ||4||28||98||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within and contained amongst all. ||4||28||98||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur paramesur poojeeaai man tan lai piaar ||
verses.translation: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa jeea kaa sabhasai dhei adhaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bachan kamaavane sachaa eh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin saadhoo sa(n)gat ratiaa maiaa moh sabh chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere saajan har har naam samaal ||
verses.translation: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat man vasai pooran hovai ghaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought to perfect fruition. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur samarath apaar gur vaddabhaagee dharasan hoi ||
verses.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur agochar niramalaa gur jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur karataa gur karanahaar gurmukh sachee soi ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur te baahar kichh nahee gur keetaa loRe su hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur teerath gur paarajaat gur manasaa pooranahaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhaataa har naam dhei udharai sabh sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord, by which all the world is saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur samarath gur nira(n)kaar gur uoochaa agam apaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kee mahimaa agam hai kiaa kathe kathanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੜੇ ਫਲ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jitaRe fal man baachhe'eeh titaRe satigur paas ||
verses.translation: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhe paavane saach naam dhe raas ||
verses.translation: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saranee aaiaa(n) baahuR nahee binaas ||
verses.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੯॥
verses.translit: har naanak kadhe na visarau eh jeeau pi(n)dd teraa saas ||4||29||99||
verses.translation: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours. ||4||29||99||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janahu sun bhaieeho chhooTan saachai nai ||
verses.translation: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan sarevane teerath har kaa naau ||
verses.translation: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aagai dharageh ma(n)ne'eeh milai nithaave thaau ||1||
verses.translation: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re saachee satigur sev ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tuThai paieeaai pooran alakh abhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur viTahu vaariaa jin dhitaa sach naau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin sach salaahanaa sache ke gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache sachaa naau ||2||
verses.translation: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: saas giraas na visarai safal moorat gur aap ||
verses.translation: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment of Fulfillment.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur jevadd avar na dhisiee aaTh pahar tis jaap ||
verses.translation: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa paieeaai sach naam gunataas ||3||
verses.translation: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur paramesar ek hai sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading and permeating amongst all.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa seiee naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
verses.translit: naanak gur saranaagatee marai na aavai jai ||4||30||100||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go in reincarnation. ||4||30||100||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਪੈ ਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakh aakh man vaavanaa jiau jiau jaapai vai ||
verses.translation: I speak and chant His Praises, vibrating the instrument of my mind. The more I know Him, the more I vibrate it.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no vai sunaieeaai so kevadd kit thai ||
verses.translation: The One, unto whom we vibrate and sing-how great is He, and where is His Place?

verses.original: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aakhan vaale jetaRe sabh aakh rahe liv lai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who speak of Him and praise Him-they all continue speaking of Him with love. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa alahu agam apaar ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the Lord Allah is Inaccessible and Infinite.

verses.original: ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕ ਥਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paakee naiee paak thai sachaa paravadhigaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sacred is His Name, and Sacred is His Place. He is the True Cherisher. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa likh na jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: The extent of Your Command cannot be seen; no one knows how to write it.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਸਾਇਰ ਮੇਲੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: je sau sair mele'eeh til na pujaaveh roi ||
verses.translation: Even if a hundred poets met together, they could not describe even a tiny bit of it.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: keemat kinai na paieeaa sabh sun sun aakheh soi ||2||
verses.translation: No one has found Your Value; they all merely write what they have heard again and again. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਮਰ ਸਾਲਕ ਸਾਦਕ ਸੁਹਦੇ ਅਉਰੁ ਸਹੀਦ ॥
verses.translit: peer paikaamar saalak saadhak suhadhe aaur saheedh ||
verses.translation: The Pirs, the Prophets, the spiritual teachers, the faithful, the innocents and the martyrs,

verses.original: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ ॥
verses.translit: sekh masaik kaajee mulaa dhar dharaves raseedh ||
verses.translation: the Shaikhs, the mystics, the Qazis, the Mullahs and the Dervishes at His Door

verses.original: ਬਰਕਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਗਲੀ ਪੜਦੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: barakat tin kau agalee paRadhe rahan dharoodh ||3||
verses.translation: -they are blessed all the more as they continue reading their prayers in praise to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਾਜੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਢਾਹੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: puchh na saaje puchh na ddaahe puchh na dhevai lei ||
verses.translation: He seeks no advice when He builds; He seeks no advice when He destroys. He seeks no advice while giving or taking.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee kudharat aape jaanai aape karan karei ||
verses.translation: He alone knows His Creative Power; He Himself does all deeds.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa vekhai nadhar kar jai bhaavai tai dhei ||4||
verses.translation: He beholds all in His Vision. He gives to those with whom He is pleased. ||4||

verses.original: ਥਾਵਾ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: thaavaa naav na jaane'eeh naavaa kevadd naau ||
verses.translation: His Place and His Name are not known, no one knows how great is His Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jithai vasai meraa paatisaahu so kevadd hai thaau ||
verses.translation: How great is that place where my Sovereign Lord dwells?

verses.original: ਅੰਬੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਣਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)baR koi na sakiee hau kis no puchhan jaau ||5||
verses.translation: No one can reach it; whom shall I go and ask? ||5||

verses.original: ਵਰਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: varanaa varan na bhaavanee je kisai vaddaa karei ||
verses.translation: One class of people does not like the other, when one has been made great.

verses.original: ਵਡੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: vadde hath vaddiaaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
verses.translation: Greatness is only in His Great Hands; He gives to those with whom He is pleased.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਢਿਲ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hukam savaare aapanai chasaa na ddil karei ||6||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He Himself regenerates, without a moment's delay. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੈਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut lainai kai veechaar ||
verses.translation: Everyone cries out, ""More! More!"", with the idea of receiving.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kevadd dhaataa aakheeaai dhe kai rahiaa sumaar ||
verses.translation: How great should we call the Giver? His Gifts are beyond estimation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੭॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak toT na aaviee tere jugeh jugeh bha(n)ddaar ||7||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no deficiency; Your Storehouses are filled to overflowing, age after age. ||7||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਗਲੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe ka(n)t maheleeaa sagaleeaa kareh seegaar ||
verses.translation: All are brides of the Husband Lord; all decorate themselves for Him.

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ganat ganaavan aaieeaa soohaa ves vikaar ||
verses.translation: But when the time comes to settle their accounts, their red robes are corrupt.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd prem na paieeaai khoTaa paaj khuaar ||1||
verses.translation: His Love is not obtained through hypocrisy. Her false coverings bring only ruin. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਇਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau iau pir raavai naar ||
verses.translation: In this way, the Dear Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys His bride.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavan sohaaganee apanee kirapaa laih savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride is pleasing to You, Lord; by Your Grace, You adorn her. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee seegaareeaa tan man pir kai paas ||
verses.translation: She is decorated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; her mind and body belong to her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਖੜੀ ਤਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR khaRee takai sach kahai aradhaas ||
verses.translation: With her palms pressed together, she stands, waiting on Him, and offers her True prayers to Him.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਇ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laal ratee sach bhai vasee bhai ratee ra(n)g raas ||2||
verses.translation: Dyed in the deep crimson of the Love of her Darling Lord, she dwells in the Fear of the True One. Imbued with His Love, she is dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਲਾਲੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pria kee cheree kaa(n)ddeeaai laalee maanai naau ||
verses.translation: She is said to be the hand-maiden of her Beloved Lord; His sweetheart surrenders to His Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saachee preet na tuTiee saache mel milaau ||
verses.translation: True Love is never broken; she is united in Union with the True One.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਧਿਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh ratee man vedhiaa hau sadh balihaarai jaau ||3||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, her mind is pierced through. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਬੈਸਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan ra(n)dd na baisiee je satigur maeh samai ||
verses.translation: That bride, who is absorbed into the True Guru, shall never become a widow.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਨਉਤਨੋ ਸਾਚਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pir reesaaloo nautano saachau marai na jai ||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord is Beautiful; His Body is forever fresh and new. The True One does not die, and shall not go.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: nit ravai sohaaganee saachee nadhar rajai ||4||
verses.translation: He continually enjoys His happy soul-bride; He casts His Gracious Glance of Truth upon her, and she abides in His Will. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਧੜੀ ਧਨ ਮਾਡੀਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saach dhaRee dhan maaddeeaai kaapaR prem seegaar ||
verses.translation: The bride braids her hair with Truth; her clothes are decorated with His Love.

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
