verses.translit: cha(n)dhan cheet vasaiaa ma(n)dhar dhasavaa dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Like the essence of sandalwood, He permeates her consciousness, and the Temple of the Tenth Gate is opened.

verses.original: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dheepak sabadh vigaasiaa raam naam ur haar ||5||
verses.translation: The lamp of the Shabad is lit, and the Name of the Lord is her necklace. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naaree a(n)dhar sohanee masatak manee piaar ||
verses.translation: She is the most beautiful among women; upon her forehead she wears the Jewel of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sobhaa surat suhaavanee saachai prem apaar ||
verses.translation: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin pir purakh na jaaniee saache gur kai het piaar ||6||
verses.translation: Other than her Beloved Lord, she knows no man. She enshrines love for the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੁਤੀਏ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nis a(n)dhiaaree sute'ee kiau pir bin rain vihai ||
verses.translation: Asleep in the darkness of the night, how shall she pass her life-night without her Husband?

verses.original: ਅੰਕੁ ਜਲਉ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲੀਅਉ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)k jalau tan jaaleeaau man dhan jal bal jai ||
verses.translation: Her limbs shall burn, her body shall burn, and her mind and wealth shall burn as well.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਤਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jaa dhan ka(n)t na raaveeaa taa birathaa joban jai ||7||
verses.translation: When the Husband does not enjoy His bride, then her youth passes away in vain. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੜੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sejai ka(n)t mahelaRee sootee boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: The Husband is on the Bed, but the bride is asleep, and so she does not come to know Him.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau sutee pir jaaganaa kis kau poochhau jai ||
verses.translation: While I am asleep, my Husband Lord is awake. Where can I go for advice?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur melee bhai vasee naanak prem sakhai ||8||2||
verses.translation: The True Guru has led me to meet Him, and now I dwell in the Fear of God. O Nanak, His Love is always with me. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape gun aape kathai aape sun veechaar ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are Your Own Glorious Praise. You Yourself speak it; You Yourself hear it and contemplate it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape ratan parakh too(n) aape mol apaar ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Jewel, and You are the Appraiser. You Yourself are of Infinite Value.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saachau maan mahat too(n) aape dhevanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: O True Lord, You are Honor and Glory; You Yourself are the Giver. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau too(n) karataa karataar ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the Creator and the Cause.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) har naam milai aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If it is Your Will, please save and protect me; please bless me with the lifestyle of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
verses.translit: aape heeraa niramalaa aape ra(n)g majeeTh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the flawless diamond; You Yourself are the deep crimson color.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਤੀ ਊਜਲੋ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape motee uoojalo aape bhagat baseeTh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the perfect pearl; You Yourself are the devotee and the priest.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠੁ ਅਡੀਠੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh salaahanaa ghaT ghaT ddeeTh addeeTh ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are praised. In each and every heart, the Unseen is seen. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape saagar bohithaa aape paar apaar ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the ocean and the boat. You Yourself are this shore, and the one beyond.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਵਾਟ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachee vaaT sujaan too(n) sabadh laghaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: O All-knowing Lord, You are the True Way. The Shabad is the Navigator to ferry us across.

verses.original: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niddariaa ddar jaaneeaai baajh guroo gubaar ||3||
verses.translation: One who does not fear God shall live in fear; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੇਤੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: asathir karataa dhekheeaai hor ketee aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal; all others come and go.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਬੰਧੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape niramal ek too(n) hor ba(n)dhee dha(n)dhai pai ||
verses.translation: Only You, Lord, are Immaculate and Pure. All others are bound up in worldly pursuits.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare saache siau liv lai ||4||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They are lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sabadh pachhaaneeaai saach rate gur vaak ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, they recognize the Dear Lord; through the Guru's Word, they are attuned to Truth.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਓਤਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: tit tan mail na lagiee sach ghar jis otaak ||
verses.translation: Filth does not stick to the body of one who has secured a dwelling in his True Home.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਕੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare sach paieeaai bin naavai kiaa saak ||5||
verses.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name. Without the Name, who are our relatives? ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sach pachhaaniaa se sukhe'ee jug chaar ||
verses.translation: Those who have realized the Truth are at peace throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai tirasanaa maar kai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Subduing their egotism and desires, they keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jag meh laahaa ek naam paieeaai gur veechaar ||6||
verses.translation: In this world, the only real profit is the Name of the One Lord; it is earned by contemplating the Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਾਦੀਐ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: saachau vakhar laadheeaai laabh sadhaa sach raas ||
verses.translation: Loading the Merchandise of the True Name, you shall gather in your profits forever with the Capital of Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: saachee dharageh baisiee bhagat sachee aradhaas ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the True One, you shall sit in truthful devotion and prayer.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: pat siau lekhaa nibaRai raam naam paragaas ||7||
verses.translation: Your account shall be settled with honor, in the Radiant Light of the Name of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਊਚਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: uoochaa uoochau aakheeaai kahau na dhekhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is said to be the Highest of the High; no one can perceive Him.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh ek too(n) satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see only You. The True Guru has inspired me to see You.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: jot nira(n)tar jaaneeaai naanak sahaj subhai ||8||3||
verses.translation: The Divine Light within is revealed, O Nanak, through this intuitive understanding. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਰੁ ਖਾਰਾ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: machhulee jaal na jaaniaa sar khaaraa asagaahu ||
verses.translation: The fish did not notice the net in the deep and salty sea.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: at siaanee sohanee kiau keeto vesaahu ||
verses.translation: It was so clever and beautiful, but why was it so confident?

verses.original: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਕੜੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਸਿਰਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: keete kaaran paakaRee kaal na Talai siraahu ||1||
verses.translation: By its actions it was caught, and now death cannot be turned away from its head. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re iau sir jaanahu kaal ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, just like this, see death hovering over your own heads!

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੀ ਤਿਉ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau machhee tiau maanasaa pavai achi(n)taa jaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧੋ ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag baadho kaal ko bin gur kaal afaar ||
verses.translation: The whole world is bound by death; without the Guru, death cannot be avoided.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sach rate se ubare dhubidhaa chhodd vikaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; they renounce duality and corruption.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau tin kai balihaaranai dhar sachai sachiaar ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be Truthful in the True Court. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੀਚਾਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਜਾਲੀ ਬਧਿਕ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: seechaane jiau pa(n)kheeaa jaalee badhik haath ||
verses.translation: Think of the hawk preying on the birds, and the net in the hands of the hunter.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਚੋਗੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare hor faathe chogai saath ||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; the others are caught by the bait.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin naavai chun suTe'eeh koi na sa(n)gee saath ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they are picked up and thrown away; they have no friends or companions. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sacho sachaa aakheeaai sache sachaa thaan ||
verses.translation: God is said to be the Truest of the True; His Place is the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sachaa ma(n)niaa tin man sach dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Those who obey the True One-their minds abide in true meditation.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man mukh sooche jaane'eeh gurmukh jinaa giaan ||4||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh, and obtain spiritual wisdom-their minds and mouths are known to be pure. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur agai aradhaas kar saajan dhei milai ||
verses.translation: Offer your most sincere prayers to the True Guru, so that He may unite you with your Best Friend.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saajan miliaai sukh paiaa jamadhoot mue bikh khai ||
verses.translation: Meeting your Best Friend, you shall find peace; the Messenger of Death shall take poison and die.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਸਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naavai a(n)dhar hau vasaa(n) naau vasai man aai ||5||
verses.translation: I dwell deep within the Name; the Name has come to dwell within my mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo gubaar hai bin sabadhai boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness; without the Shabad, understanding is not obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee paragaas hoi sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be enlightened; remain absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਚਰੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tithai kaal na sa(n)charai jotee jot samai ||6||
verses.translation: Death does not go there; your light shall merge with the Light. ||6||

verses.original: ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too(n)hai saajan too(n) sujaan too(n) aape melanahaar ||
verses.translation: You are my Best Friend; You are All-knowing. You are the One who unites us with Yourself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee saalaaheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we praise You; You have no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tithai kaal na apaRai jithai gur kaa sabadh apaar ||7||
verses.translation: Death does not reach that place, where the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad resounds. ||7||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਭੇ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee sabhe uoopajeh hukamee kaar kamaeh ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, all are created. By His Command, actions are performed.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee kaalai vas hai hukamee saach samaeh ||
verses.translation: By His Command, all are subject to death; by His Command, they merge in Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaavai so theeaai inaa ja(n)taa vas kichh naeh ||8||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever pleases His Will comes to pass. Nothing is in the hands of these beings. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਤਨਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man jooThai tan jooTh hai jihavaa jooThee hoi ||
verses.translation: If the mind is polluted, then the body is polluted, and the tongue is polluted as well.

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mukh jhooThai jhooTh bolanaa kiau kar soochaa hoi ||
verses.translation: With false mouths, people speak falsehood. How can they be made pure?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਭ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin abh sabadh na maa(n)jeeaai saache te sach hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣਹੀਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhe gunaheenee sukh keh ||
verses.translation: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਣਸੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pir raleeaa ras maanasee saach sabadh sukh neh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: pir paradhesee je theeaai dhan vaa(n)ddee jhoorei ||
verses.translation: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥੋੜੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jal thoRai machhulee karan palaav karei ||
verses.translation: like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pir bhaavai sukh paieeaai jaa aape nadhar karei ||2||
verses.translation: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: pir saalaahee aapanaa sakhee sahelee naal ||
verses.translation: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.

verses.original: ਤਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan sohai man mohiaa ratee ra(n)g nihaal ||
verses.translation: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we are enraptured.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh savaaree sohanee pir raave gun naal ||3||
verses.translation: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖੋਟੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman kaam na aaviee khoTee avaganiaar ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਜਲੀ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa sukh peieeaai saahurai jhooTh jalee vekaar ||
verses.translation: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood and corruption.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਵੰਞਣੁ ਡਾਖੜੋ ਛੋਡੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aavan va(n)n(j)n ddaakhaRo chhoddee ka(n)t visaar ||4||
verses.translation: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten by her Husband Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਤੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: pir kee naar suhaavanee mutee so kit saadh ||
verses.translation: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she been doomed?

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਬੋਲੇ ਫਾਦਿਲੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: pir kai kaam na aaviee bole faadhil baadh ||
verses.translation: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhar ghar ddoiee naa lahai chhooTee dhoojai saadh ||5||
verses.translation: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਚਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit vaacheh potheeaa naa boojheh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand the real meaning.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮਤੀ ਦੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: an kau matee dhe chaleh maiaa kaa vaapaar ||
verses.translation: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Maya themselves.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ਰਹਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kathanee jhooThee jag bhavai rahanee sabadhu su saar ||6||
verses.translation: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true to the Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kete pa(n)ddit jotakee bedhaa kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.

verses.original: ਵਾਦਿ ਵਿਰੋਧਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੇ ਵਾਦੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaadh virodh salaahane vaadhe aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin gur karam na chhuTasee keh sun aakh vakhaan ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak and listen and preach and explain. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh gunava(n)tee aakhe'eeh mai gun naahee koi ||
verses.translation: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har var naar suhaavanee mai bhaavai prabh soi ||
verses.translation: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh milaavaRaa naa vechhoRaa hoi ||8||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam saadheeaai teerath keechai vaas ||
verses.translation: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell at sacred shrines of pilgrimage;

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan cha(n)giaaieeaa bin saache kiaa taas ||
verses.translation: you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the True One, what is the use of it all?

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਰਾਧੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਲੁਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jehaa raadhe tehaa lunai bin gun janam vinaas ||1||
verses.translation: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhe gun dhaasee sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avagan tiaag samaieeaai gurmat pooraa soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbed into the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vin raasee vaapaareeaa take ku(n)ddaa chaar ||
verses.translation: Without capital, the trader looks around in all four directions.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mool na bujhai aapanaa vasat rahee ghar baar ||
verses.translation: He does not understand his own origins; the merchandise remains within the door of his own house.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਖਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vin vakhar dhukh agalaa kooR muThee kooRiaar ||2||
verses.translation: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਉਤਨਾ ਪਰਖੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa ahinis nautanaa parakhe ratan veechaar ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.

verses.original: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vasat lahai ghar aapanai chalai kaaraj saar ||
verses.translation: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.

verses.original: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vanajaariaa siau vanaj kar gurmukh braham beechaar ||3||
verses.translation: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)gat paieeaai je mele melanahaar ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: miliaa hoi na vichhuRai jis a(n)tar jot apaar ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sachai aasan sach rahai sachai prem piaar ||4||
verses.translation: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jinee aap pachhaaniaa ghar meh mahal suthai ||
verses.translation: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai pai ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan so prabh jaaneeaai saacho saachai nai ||5||
verses.translation: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan kharee suhaavanee jin pir jaataa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

verses.original: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: mahalee mahal bulaieeaai so pir raave ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sach suhaagan saa bhalee pir mohee gun sa(n)g ||6||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਾ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolee bhoolee thal chaRaa thal chaR ddoogar jaau ||
verses.translation: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

verses.original: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ban meh bhoolee je firaa bin gur boojh na paau ||
verses.translation: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naavahu bhoolee je firaa fir fir aavau jaau ||7||
verses.translation: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

verses.original: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਧਾਊਆ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: puchhahu jai padhaauooaa chale chaakar hoi ||
verses.translation: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: raajan jaaneh aapanaa dhar ghar Thaak na hoi ||
verses.translation: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak eko rav rahiaa dhoojaa avar na koi ||8||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur te niramal jaaneeaai niramal dheh sareer ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: niramal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh peer ||
verses.translation: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahajai te sukh agalo naa laagai jam teer ||1||
verses.translation: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re mail naahee niramal jal nai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: niramal saachaa ek too hor mail bharee sabh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa ma(n)dhar sohanaa keeaa karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: rav sas dheep anoop jot tirabhavan jot apaar ||
verses.translation: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.

verses.original: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haaT paTan gaR koThaRee sach saudhaa vaapaar ||2||
verses.translation: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan bhai bha(n)janaa dhekh nira(n)jan bhai ||
verses.translation: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gupat pragaT sabh jaaneeaai je man raakhai Thai ||
verses.translation: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satigur je milai taa sahaje le milai ||3||
verses.translation: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਖੇ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kas kasavaTee laieeaai parakhe hit chit lai ||
verses.translation: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.

verses.original: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khoTe Thaur na painee khare khajaanai pai ||
verses.translation: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aas a(n)dhesaa dhoor kar iau mal jai samai ||4||
verses.translation: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh kau maagai sabh ko dhukh na maagai koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukhai kau dhukh agalaa manmukh boojh na hoi ||
verses.translation: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh sam kar jaane'eeh sabadh bhedh sukh hoi ||5||
verses.translation: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh pukaare vaacheeaai baanee braham biaas ||
verses.translation: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,

verses.original: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: mun jan sevak saadhikaa naam rate gunataas ||
verses.translation: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sach rate se jin ge hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||6||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chahu jug maile mal bhare jin mukh naam na hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagatee bhai vihooniaa muh kaalaa pat khoi ||
verses.translation: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jinee naam visaariaa avagan muThee roi ||7||
verses.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਡਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat paiaa ddar kar milai milai ||
verses.translation: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaanai ghar vasai haumai tirasanaa jai ||
verses.translation: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak niramal uoojale jo raate har nai ||8||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun man bhoole baavare gur kee charanee laag ||
verses.translation: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jap naam dhiaai too jam ddarapai dhukh bhaag ||
verses.translation: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhookh ghano dhohaaganee kiau thir rahai suhaag ||1||
verses.translation: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re avar naahee mai thaau ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhan naam nidhaan hai gur dheeaa bal jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat pat saabaas tis tis kai sa(n)g milaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin ghaRee na jeevuoo bin naavai mar jaau ||
verses.translation: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai a(n)dhule naam na veesarai Tek Tikee ghar jaau ||2||
verses.translation: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my true home. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa chele naahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find their place of rest.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur naau na paieeaai bin naavai kiaa suaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the use of it all?

verses.original: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aai giaa pachhutaavanaa jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaau ||3||
verses.translation: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਲਰ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhukh dhehuree jiau kalar kee bheet ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tab lag mahal na paieeaai jab lag saach na cheet ||
verses.translation: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabadh rapai ghar paieeaai nirabaanee padh neet ||4||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau gur poochhau aapane gur puchh kaar kamaau ||
verses.translation: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh salaahee man vasai haumai dhukh jal jaau ||
verses.translation: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sahaje hoi milaavaRaa saache saach milaau ||5||
verses.translation: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate se niramale taj kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexual desire, anger, selfishness and conceit.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam salaahan sadh sadhaa har raakheh ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: so kiau manahu visaareeaai sabh jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||6||
verses.translation: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai so mar rahai fir marai na dhoojee vaar ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai hee te paieeaai har naame lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai jag bhoolaa firai mar janamai vaaro vaar ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh saalaahai aap kau vaddahu vadderee hoi ||
verses.translation: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀਐ ਕਹੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin aap na cheeneeaai kahe sune kiaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, what is accomplished?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh pachhaaneeaai haumai karai na koi ||8||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਐ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin pir dhan seegaareeaai joban baadh khuaar ||
verses.translation: Without her Husband, the soul-bride's youth and ornaments are useless and wretched.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਾਣੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa maane sukh sejaRee bin pir baadh seegaar ||
verses.translation: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments are absurd.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhookh ghano dhohaaganee naa ghar sej bhataar ||1||
verses.translation: The discarded bride suffers terrible pain; her Husband does not come to the bed of her home. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re raam japahu sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur prem na paieeaai sabadh milai ra(n)g hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, love is not found. United with the Shabad, happiness is found. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa sukh paieeaai har var sahaj seegaar ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, she finds peace, and her Husband Lord adorns her with intuitive wisdom.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਗੂੜਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach maane pir sejaRee gooRaa het piaar ||
verses.translation: Truly, she enjoys the Bed of her Husband, through her deep love and affection.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਣ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaan sin(j)aaneeaai gur melee gun chaar ||2||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, she comes to know Him. Meeting with the Guru, she maintains a virtuous lifestyle. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach milahu var kaamanee pir mohee ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband, enshrine love for Him.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan saach vigasiaa keemat kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot be described.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har var ghar sohaaganee niramal saachai nai ||3||
verses.translation: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man meh manooaa je marai taa pir raavai naar ||
verses.translation: If the mind within the mind dies, then the Husband ravishes and enjoys His bride.

verses.original: ਇਕਤੁ ਤਾਗੈ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikat taagai ral milai gal moteean kaa haar ||
verses.translation: They are woven into one texture, like pearls on a necklace around the neck.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa sukh uoopajai gurmukh naam adhaar ||4||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, peace wells up; the Gurmukhs take the Support of the Naam. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿਨਿ ਖਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh upajai khin khapai khin aavai khin jai ||
verses.translation: In an instant, one is born, and in an instant, one dies. In an instant one comes, and in an instant one goes.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh pachhaanai rav rahai naa tis kaal sa(n)tai ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes the Shabad merges into it, and is not afflicted by death.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saahib atul na toleeaai kathan na paiaa jai ||5||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is Unweighable; He cannot be weighed. He cannot be found merely by talking. ||5||

verses.original: ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaapaaree vanajaariaa aae vajahu likhai ||
verses.translation: The merchants and the traders have come; their profits are pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaar kamaaveh sach kee laahaa milai rajai ||
verses.translation: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee saachee gur milai naa tis til na tamai ||6||
verses.translation: With the Merchandise of Truth, they meet the Guru, who does not have a trace of greed. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tol tuolaisee sach taraajee tol ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa mohanee gur Thaakee sach bol ||
verses.translation: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap tulaae tolasee poore pooraa tol ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਥਨੈ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਭਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kathanai kahan na chhuTeeaai naa paR pusatak bhaar ||
verses.translation: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa soch na paieeaai bin har bhagat piaar ||
verses.translation: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੮॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai mele gur karataar ||8||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur pooraa je milai paieeaai ratan beechaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man dheejai gur aapane paieeaai sarab piaar ||
verses.translation: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukat padhaarath paieeaai avagan meTanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re gur bin giaan na hoi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਾਰਦੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poochhahu brahame naaradhai bedh biaasai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan dhun jaaneeaai akath kahaavai soi ||
verses.translation: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.

verses.original: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: safalio birakh hareeaavalaa chhaav ghaneree hoi ||
verses.translation: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laal javehar maanakee gur bha(n)ddaarai soi ||2||
verses.translation: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur bha(n)ddaarai paieeaai niramal naam piaar ||
verses.translation: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saacho vakhar sa(n)cheeaai poorai karam apaar ||
verses.translation: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa dhukh meTano satigur asur sa(n)ghaar ||3||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਨਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhavajal bikham ddaraavano naa ka(n)dhee naa paar ||
verses.translation: The terrifying world-ocean is difficult and dreadful; there is no shore on this side or the one beyond.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਵੰਝੁ ਮਲਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa tis va(n)jh malaar ||
verses.translation: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੈ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur bhai kaa bohithaa nadharee paar utaar ||4||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries us across. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik til piaaraa visarai dhukh laagai sukh jai ||
verses.translation: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਉ ਜਲਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa jalau jalaavanee naam na japai rasai ||
verses.translation: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.

verses.original: ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਜਮੁ ਪਕੜੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ghaT binasai dhukh agalo jam pakaRai pachhutai ||5||
verses.translation: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kar ge tan dhan kalat na saath ||
verses.translation: Crying out, ""Mine! Mine!"", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and their wives did not go with them.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhan baadh hai bhoolo maarag aath ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੋ ਕਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saachau saahib seveeaai gurmukh akatho kaath ||6||
verses.translation: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavai jai bhavaieeaai piaai kirat kamai ||
verses.translation: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa kiau meTeeaai likhiaa lekh rajai ||
verses.translation: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin har naam na chhuTeeaai gurmat milai milai ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are united in His Union. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin meraa ko nahee jis kaa jeeau paraan ||
verses.translation: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong to Him.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਲਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa jal balau lobh jalau abhimaan ||
verses.translation: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotistical pride consigned to the fire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh veechaareeaai paieeaai gunee nidhaan ||8||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਕਮਲੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee jal kamaleh ||
verses.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.

verses.original: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਐ ਭੀ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: laharee naal pachhaaReeaai bhee vigasai asaneh ||
verses.translation: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jal meh jeea upai kai bin jal maran tineh ||1||
verses.translation: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: man re kiau chhooTeh bin piaar ||
verses.translation: O mind, how can you be saved without love?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar rav rahiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee machhulee neer ||
verses.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅਧਿਕਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jiau adhikau tiau sukh ghano man tan saa(n)t sareer ||
verses.translation: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind and body.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin jal ghaRee na jeeviee prabh jaanai abh peer ||2||
verses.translation: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee chaatirak meh ||
verses.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

verses.original: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: sar bhar thal hareeaavale ik boo(n)dh na paviee keh ||
verses.translation: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karam milai so paieeaai kirat piaa sir dheh ||3||
verses.translation: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives her head. ||3||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee jal dhudh hoi ||
verses.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.

verses.original: ਆਵਟਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਣਿ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavaTan aape khavai dhudh kau khapan na dhei ||
verses.translation: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk from burning.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape mel vichhu(n)niaa sach vaddiaaiee dhei ||4||
verses.translation: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee chakavee soor ||
verses.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal needh na soviee jaanai dhoor hajoor ||
verses.translation: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinks that it is near.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: manmukh sojhee naa pavai gurmukh sadhaa hajoor ||5||
verses.translation: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ganat ganaavanee karataa kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions of the Creator come to pass.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmat hoi ta paieeaai sach milai sukh hoi ||6||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa neh na tuTiee je satigur bheTai soi ||
verses.translation: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan padhaarath paieeaai tirabhavan sojhee hoi ||
verses.translation: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: niramal naam na veesarai je gun kaa gaahak hoi ||7||
verses.translation: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ ਸਰ ਤਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: khel ge se pa(n)khanoo(n) jo chugadhe sar tal ||
verses.translation: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaRee k muhat k chalanaa khelan aj k kal ||
verses.translation: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) meleh so milai jai sachaa piR mal ||8||
verses.translation: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arena of Truth. ||8||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur preet na uoopajai haumai mail na jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.

verses.original: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: soha(n) aap pachhaaneeaai sabadh bhedh pateeaai ||
verses.translation: One who recognizes within himself that, ""He is me"", and who is pierced through by the Shabad, is satisfied.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap pachhaaneeaai avar k kare karai ||9||
verses.translation: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to do or have done? ||9||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: miliaa kaa kiaa meleeaai sabadh mile pateeaai ||
verses.translation: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving the Shabad, they are satisfied.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sojhee naa pavai veechhuR choTaa khai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endure beatings.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhar ghar ek hai avar na dhoojee jai ||10||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all. ||10||11||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhulai bhulaieeaai bhoolee Thaur na kai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ਅੰਧੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin ko na dhikhaaviee a(n)dhee aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: giaan padhaarath khoiaa Thagiaa muThaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa maiaa bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਰ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulee ddohaaganee naa pir a(n)k samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolee firai dhisa(n)taree bhoolee girahu taj jai ||
verses.translation: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons her own home.

verses.original: ਭੂਲੀ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਥਲਿ ਚੜੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhoolee ddoo(n)gar thal chaRai bharamai man ddolai ||
verses.translation: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhurahu vichhu(n)nee kiau milai garab muThee bilalai ||2||
verses.translation: Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa gur melasee har ras naam piaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saach sahaj sobhaa ghanee har gun naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too(n) mai tujh bin kavan bhataar ||3||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||

verses.original: ਅਖਰ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: akhar paR paR bhuleeaai bhekhee bahut abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: teerath naataa kiaa kare man meh mail gumaan ||
verses.translation: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur bin kin samajhaieeaai man raajaa sulataan ||4||
verses.translation: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prem padhaarath paieeaai gurmukh tat veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan aap gavaiaa gur kai sabadh seegaar ||
verses.translation: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ghar hee so pir paiaa gur kai het apaar ||5||
verses.translation: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa chaakaree man niramal sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh man vasiaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath paiaa laabh sadhaa man hoi ||6||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karam milai taa paieeaai aap na liaa jai ||
verses.translation: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee charanee lag rahu vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai pai ||7||
verses.translation: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||

verses.original: ਭੁਲਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhulan a(n)dhar sabh ko abhul guroo karataar ||
verses.translation: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat man samajhaiaa laagaa tisai piaar ||
verses.translation: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saach na veesarai mele sabadh apaar ||8||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਘਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa maiaa mohanee sut ba(n)dhap ghar naar ||
verses.translation: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhan joban jag Thagiaa lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh Thagaulee hau muiee saa varatai sa(n)saar ||1||
verses.translation: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetamaa mai tujh bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai tujh bin avar na bhaaviee too(n) bhaaveh sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam saalaahee ra(n)g siau gur kai sabadh sa(n)tokh ||
verses.translation: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so chalasee kooRaa moh na vekh ||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.

verses.original: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vaaT vaTaauoo aaiaa nit chaladhaa saath dhekh ||2||
verses.translation: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan aakheh ketaRe gur bin boojh na hoi ||
verses.translation: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam vaddaiee je milai sach rapai pat hoi ||
verses.translation: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaaveh se bhale khoTaa kharaa na koi ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur saranaiee chhuTeeaai manmukh khoTee raas ||
verses.translation: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.

verses.original: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: asaT dhaat paatisaeh kee ghaReeaai sabadh vigaas ||
verses.translation: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape parakhe paarakhoo pavai khajaanai raas ||4||
verses.translation: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: teree keemat naa pavai sabh ddiThee Thok vajai ||
verses.translation: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.

verses.original: ਕਹਣੈ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahanai haath na labhiee sach Tikai pat pai ||
verses.translation: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmat too(n) saalaahanaa hor keemat kahan na jai ||5||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jit tan naam na bhaaviee tit tan haumai vaadh ||
verses.translation: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin giaan na paieeaai bikhiaa dhoojaa saadh ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੀਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin gun kaam na aaviee maiaa feekaa saadh ||6||
verses.translation: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa a(n)dhar ja(n)miaa aasaa ras kas khai ||
verses.translation: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa ba(n)dh chalaieeaai muhe muh choTaa khai ||
verses.translation: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਧਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: avagan badhaa maareeaai chhooTai gurmat nai ||7||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarabe thaiee ek too(n) jiau bhaavai tiau raakh ||
verses.translation: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat saachaa man vasai naam bhalo pat saakh ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. The Companionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: haumai rog gavaieeaai sabadh sachai sach bhaakh ||8||
verses.translation: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the True Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਆਕਾਸੀ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakaasee paataal too(n) tirabhavan rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the three worlds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhagatee bhaau too(n) aape mileh milai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union with Yourself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai jiau bhaavai tivai rajai ||9||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam man bedhiaa avar k karee veechaar ||
verses.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh surat sukh uoopajai prabh raatau sukh saar ||
verses.translation: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) mai har naam adhaar ||1||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re saachee khasam rajai ||
verses.translation: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin tan man saaj seegaariaa tis setee liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਕਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan baisa(n)tar homeeaai ik ratee tol kaTai ||
verses.translation: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan man samadhaa je karee anadhin agan jalai ||
verses.translation: and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in the fire,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har naamai tul na pujiee je lakh koTee karam kamai ||2||
verses.translation: and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all these are not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aradh sareer kaTaieeaai sir karavat dharai ||
verses.translation: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਹੈਮੰਚਲਿ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan haima(n)chal gaaleeaai bhee man te rog na jai ||
verses.translation: and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free of disease.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naamai tul na pujiee sabh ddiThee Thok vajai ||3||
verses.translation: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਦਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan ke koT dhat karee bahu haivar gaivar dhaan ||
verses.translation: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrous elephants in charity,

verses.original: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਗਊਆ ਘਣੀ ਭੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhoom dhaan guooaa ghanee bhee a(n)tar garab gumaan ||
verses.translation: and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still be within me.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: raam naam man bedhiaa gur dheeaa sach dhaan ||4||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift. ||4||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠ ਬੁਧੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh budhee keteeaa kete bedh beechaar ||
verses.translation: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplate the Vedas.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: kete ba(n)dhan jeea ke gurmukh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gate of Liberation.

verses.original: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sachahu orai sabh ko upar sach aachaar ||5||
verses.translation: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਊਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko uoochaa aakheeaai neech na dheesai koi ||
verses.translation: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.

verses.original: ਇਕਨੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eikanai bhaa(n)dde saajiaai ik chaanan tih loi ||
verses.translation: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: karam milai sach paieeaai dhur bakhas na meTai koi ||6||
verses.translation: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saadh milai saadhoo janai sa(n)tokh vasai gur bhai ||
verses.translation: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa veechaareeaai je satigur maeh samai ||
verses.translation: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.

verses.original: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: pee a(n)mrit sa(n)tokhiaa dharageh paidhaa jai ||7||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||7||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT vaajai ki(n)guree anadhin sabadh subhai ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, with sublime love for the Shabad.

verses.original: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: virale kau sojhee piee gurmukh man samajhai ||
verses.translation: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai chhooTai sabadh kamai ||8||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਿਤੇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਬਗੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: chite dhiseh dhaulahar bage ba(n)k dhuaar ||
verses.translation: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar man khusee usaariaa dhoojai het piaar ||
verses.translation: they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar khaalee prem bin ddeh dderee tan chhaar ||1||
verses.translation: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re tan dhan saath na hoi ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan niramalo gur dhaat kare prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan niramalo je dhevai dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.
