verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aagai poochh na hoviee jis belee gur karataar ||
verses.translation: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh jaanai aapane dheeaa poot sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naaree dhekh vigaase'eeh naale harakhu su sog ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh ra(n)gaavale ahinis har ras bhog ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਵਣੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chit chalai vit jaavano saakat ddol ddolai ||
verses.translation: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search of transitory wealth, unstable and distracted.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baahar ddoo(n)dd vigucheeaai ghar meh vasat suthai ||
verses.translation: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in that sacred place within the home of the heart.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: manmukh haumai kar musee gurmukh palai pai ||4||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saakat niraguniaariaa aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
verses.translation: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!

verses.original: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੋ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: rakat bi(n)dh kaa ih tano aganee paas piraan ||
verses.translation: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.

verses.original: ਪਵਣੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pavanai kai vas dhehuree masatak sach neesaan ||5||
verses.translation: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮੁਆ ਨ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahutaa jeevan ma(n)geeaai muaa na loRai koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukh jeevan tis aakheeaai jis gurmukh vasiaa soi ||
verses.translation: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naam vihoone kiaa ganee jis har gur dharas na hoi ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Lord and Guru? ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau supanai nis bhuleeaai jab lag nidhraa hoi ||
verses.translation: In their dreams at night, people wander around as long as they sleep;

verses.original: ਇਉ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eiau sarapan kai vas jeeaRaa a(n)tar haumai dhoi ||
verses.translation: just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filled with ego and duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmat hoi veechaareeaai supanaa ih jag loi ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world is just a dream. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੂਧੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: agan marai jal paieeaai jiau baarik dhoodhai mai ||
verses.translation: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin jal kamal su naa theeaai bin jal meen marai ||
verses.translation: and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har ras milai jeevaa har gun gai ||8||15||
verses.translation: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15||

verses.original: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡਰੀਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddoo(n)gar dhekh ddaraavano peieeaRai ddareeaas ||
verses.translation: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.

verses.original: ਊਚਉ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਗਾਖੜੋ ਨਾ ਪਉੜੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: uoochau parabat gaakhaRo naa pauRee tit taas ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਰੀਆਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar jaaniaa gur melee tareeaas ||1||
verses.translation: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union, and so I cross over. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re bhavajal bikham ddaraa(n)au ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur ras milai gur taare har naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me, through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਲਾ ਚਲਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: chalaa chalaa je karee jaanaa chalanahaar ||
verses.translation: I may say, ""I am going, I am going"", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo aaiaa so chalasee amaru su gur karataar ||
verses.translation: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.

verses.original: ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhee sachaa saalaahanaa sachai thaan piaar ||2||
verses.translation: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਪਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhar ghar mahalaa sohane pake koT hajaar ||
verses.translation: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,

verses.original: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hasatee ghoRe paakhare lasakar lakh apaar ||
verses.translation: elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kis hee naal na chaliaa khap khap mue asaar ||3||
verses.translation: -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਮਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: suinaa rupaa sa(n)cheeaai maal jaal ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag meh dhohee fereeaai bin naavai sir kaal ||
verses.translation: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without the Name, death hovers over your head.

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਜੀਉ ਖੇਲਸੀ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd paRai jeeau khelasee badhafailee kiaa haal ||4||
verses.translation: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||

verses.original: ਪੁਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਐ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: putaa dhekh vigaseeaai naaree sej bhataar ||
verses.translation: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.

verses.original: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: choaa cha(n)dhan laieeaai kaapaR roop seegaar ||
verses.translation: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.

verses.original: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: khehoo kheh ralaieeaai chhodd chalai ghar baar ||5||
verses.translation: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਈਐ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਉ ਕਿ ਖਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: mahar malook kahaieeaai raajaa raau k khaan ||
verses.translation: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;

verses.original: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਉ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਜਲਿ ਬਲੀਐ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: chaudharee raau sadhaieeaai jal baleeaai abhimaan ||
verses.translation: he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire of egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਵਿ ਦਧਾ ਕਾਨੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh naam visaariaa jiau ddav dhadhaa kaan ||6||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in the forest fire. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai kar kar jaisee jo aaiaa jag maeh ||
verses.translation: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart.
